1	"""Query plan builder.
2	
3	Turns an executable GraphQL document plus resolved variables into a scan/join
4	plan over the entities declared in the schema. All validation failures raise
5	PlanError with the appropriate code; no partial plan is produced.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
11	
12	from .errors import PlanError
13	from .gql import (
14	    FieldNode,
15	    FragmentSpread,
16	    InlineFragment,
17	    Var,
18	    parse_executable,
19	)
20	from .schema import Schema, TypeInfo, named_of
21	
22	# Field arguments accepted as list-size bounds while query complexity control
23	# is enabled, in priority order. Only present when a bound limit is configured,
24	# so baseline argument validation is unchanged when the control is off.
25	BOUND_ARG_NAMES = ("first", "limit")
26	
27	
28	def _is_list_type(type_ref) -> bool:
29	    """Whether a (possibly non-null wrapped) field type is a list."""
30	    if type_ref[0] == "non_null":
31	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
32	    return type_ref[0] == "list"
33	
34	
35	class Planner:
36	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, variables: Dict[str, Any],
37	                 bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
38	        self.schema = schema
39	        self.variables = variables
40	        # When a complexity limit is configured, list fields accept first/limit
41	        # bounds (literal or variable); otherwise arguments stay unsupported.
42	        self.bound_args_allowed = bound_args_allowed
43	        self.fragments: Dict[str, Any] = {}
44	        self.var_map: Dict[str, tuple] = {}
45	        self.joins: List[dict] = []
46	
47	    # -- complexity bound arguments ------------------------------------------
48	
49	    def _accepts_bound_arg(self, is_list_field: bool, arg_name: str) -> bool:
50	        """Whether a first/limit argument is accepted on this field.
51	
52	        Bound arguments are only recognized while complexity control is
53	        enabled and only on list-returning fields; everywhere else the field's
54	        ordinary argument validation (unknown argument / arguments not
55	        supported) keeps applying, so baseline behavior is unchanged.
56	        """
57	        return (
58	            self.bound_args_allowed
59	            and is_list_field
60	            and arg_name in BOUND_ARG_NAMES
61	        )
62	
63	    # -- entry point ---------------------------------------------------------
64	
65	    def plan(self, query_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]) -> dict:
66	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
67	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
68	        self.var_map = {}
69	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
70	            if name in self.var_map:
71	                raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once")
72	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
73	
74	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get(op.op_type)
75	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
76	        if root_type is None:
77	            raise PlanError(
78	                "UnknownField",
79	                f"schema does not define a root type for {op.op_type} operations",
80	            )
81	
82	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
83	        if not selections:
84	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "operation has an empty selection set")
85	
86	        plan = {
87	            "operationType": op.op_type,
88	            "operationName": op.name,
89	            "roots": [],
90	            "joins": self.joins,
91	        }
92	        for node in selections:
93	            plan["roots"].append(self._plan_root(node, root_type))
94	        return plan
95	
96	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
97	
98	    @staticmethod
99	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
100	        if operation_name is not None:
101	            for op in operations:
102	                if op.name == operation_name:
103	                    if op.op_type == "subscription":
104	                        raise PlanError(
105	                            "UnsupportedOperation",
106	                            "subscription operations are not supported",
107	                        )
108	                    return op
109	            raise PlanError("InvalidOperation", f"no operation named '{operation_name}'")
110	        candidates = [op for op in operations if op.op_type in ("query", "mutation")]
111	        if len(candidates) == 1:
112	            return candidates[0]
113	        if not operations:
114	            raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", "document contains no operations")
115	        if not candidates and len(operations) == 1:
116	            raise PlanError(
117	                "UnsupportedOperation", "subscription operations are not supported"
118	            )
119	        raise PlanError(
120	            "InvalidRequest",
121	            "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
122	        )
123	
124	    # -- fragment expansion ------------------------------------------------------
125	
126	    def _type_condition_matches(self, condition: str, type_name: str) -> bool:
127	        if condition == type_name:
128	            return True
129	        info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
130	        if info is not None and condition in info.interfaces:
131	            return True
132	        members = self.schema.unions.get(condition)
133	        return bool(members) and type_name in members
134	
135	    def _expand(self, selections, type_name: str, stack: List[str]) -> List[FieldNode]:
136	        """Inline fragments and merge fields by response key, preserving order."""
137	        out: List[FieldNode] = []
138	        index: Dict[str, FieldNode] = {}
139	
140	        def add(node: FieldNode) -> None:
141	            key = node.alias or node.name
142	            existing = index.get(key)
143	            if existing is None:
144	                index[key] = FieldNode(
145	                    node.name,
146	                    node.alias,
147	                    dict(node.args),
148	                    list(node.selection_set) if node.selection_set is not None else None,
149	                )
150	                out.append(index[key])
151	                return
152	            if existing.name != node.name:
153	                raise PlanError(
154	                    "InvalidQuery",
155	                    f"conflicting fields '{existing.name}' and '{node.name}' share response key '{key}'",
156	                )
157	            if (existing.selection_set is None) != (node.selection_set is None):
158	                raise PlanError(
159	                    "InvalidQuery", f"conflicting selections for response key '{key}'"
160	                )
161	            if existing.selection_set is not None:
162	                existing.selection_set.extend(node.selection_set)
163	
164	        for sel in selections:
165	            if isinstance(sel, FieldNode):
166	                add(sel)
167	            elif isinstance(sel, FragmentSpread):
168	                frag = self.fragments.get(sel.name)
169	                if frag is None:
170	                    raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"unknown fragment '{sel.name}'")
171	                if sel.name in stack:
172	                    raise PlanError(
173	                        "InvalidQuery", f"fragment cycle involving '{sel.name}'"
174	                    )
175	                if self._type_condition_matches(frag.type_condition, type_name):
176	                    for node in self._expand(frag.selection_set, type_name, stack + [sel.name]):
177	                        add(node)
178	            elif isinstance(sel, InlineFragment):
179	                if sel.type_condition is None or self._type_condition_matches(
180	                    sel.type_condition, type_name
181	                ):
182	                    for node in self._expand(sel.selection_set, type_name, stack):
183	                        add(node)
184	        return out
185	
186	    # -- variables ------------------------------------------------------------
187	
188	    def _resolve(self, value: Any) -> Any:
189	        if isinstance(value, Var):
190	            name = value.name
191	            if name not in self.var_map:
192	                raise PlanError(
193	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is not declared by the operation"
194	                )
195	            type_ref, default, has_default = self.var_map[name]
196	            if name in self.variables:
197	                provided = self.variables[name]
198	                if not self._check_type(type_ref, provided):
199	                    raise PlanError(
200	                        "VariablesError",
201	                        f"variable '${name}' has a value of the wrong type",
202	                    )
203	                return provided
204	            if has_default:
205	                return default
206	            raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' was not provided")
207	        if isinstance(value, list):
208	            return [self._resolve(item) for item in value]
209	        if isinstance(value, dict):
210	            return {key: self._resolve(item) for key, item in value.items()}
211	        return value
212	
213	    def _check_type(self, type_ref, value) -> bool:
214	        kind = type_ref[0]
215	        if kind == "non_null":

217	        if value is None:

222	            )
223	        name = type_ref[1]
224	        if name == "Int":

226	        if name == "Float":
227	            return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
228	        if name == "String":
229	            return isinstance(value, str)
230	        if name == "Boolean":
231	            return isinstance(value, bool)
232	        if name == "ID":
233	            return isinstance(value, (str, int)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
234	        if name in self.schema.scalars:
235	            return True
236	        if name in self.schema.enums:
237	            return isinstance(value, str)
238	        input_def = self.schema.inputs.get(name)
239	        if input_def is not None:
240	            if not isinstance(value, dict):
241	                return False
242	            for field_name, field_def in input_def.items():
243	                if (
244	                    field_def.type[0] == "non_null"
245	                    and not field_def.has_default
246	                    and field_name not in value
247	                ):
248	                    return False
249	                if field_name in value and not self._check_type(
250	                    field_def.type, value[field_name]
251	                ):

253	            return True
254	        return True  # unknown named type: accept

256	    # -- roots ------------------------------------------------------------------
257	
258	    def _plan_root(self, node: FieldNode, root_type: TypeInfo) -> dict:
259	        key = node.alias or node.name
260	        field = root_type.fields.get(node.name)
261	        if field is None:
262	            raise PlanError(
263	                "UnknownField", f"unknown root field '{node.name}' on type '{root_type.name}'"
264	            )
265	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
266	        target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
267	        entity = target.entity if target is not None else None
268	        if entity is None:
269	            raise PlanError(
270	                "UnknownEntity",
271	                f"root field '{node.name}' does not return a mapped entity type",
272	            )
273	        if node.selection_set is None:
274	            raise PlanError(
275	                "InvalidQuery", f"root field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
276	            )
277	        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
278	            if (
279	                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
280	                and not arg_def.has_default
281	                and arg_name not in node.args
282	            ):
283	                raise PlanError(
284	                    "UnknownField",
285	                    f"missing required argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
286	                )
287	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
288	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
289	            if arg_name not in field.args:
290	                raise PlanError(
291	                    "UnknownField",
292	                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
293	                )
294	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
295	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
296	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
297	            ):
298	                raise PlanError(
299	                    "UnknownField",
300	                    f"argument '{arg_name}' does not match a filterable field of entity '{entity.table}'",
301	                )
302	            filter_obj[arg_name] = self._resolve(value)
303	        entry = {"path": key, "entity": entity.table, "filter": filter_obj, "fields": []}
304	        self._walk(target, entity, node.selection_set, key, entry)
305	        return entry
306	
307	    # -- nested selections --------------------------------------------------------
308	
309	    def _walk(self, info: TypeInfo, entity, selection_set, path: str, entry: dict) -> None:
310	        selections = self._expand(selection_set, info.name, [])
311	        if not selections:
312	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"empty selection set at '{path}'")
313	        for node in selections:
314	            key = node.alias or node.name
315	            node_path = f"{path}.{key}"
316	            field = info.fields.get(node.name)
317	            if field is None:
318	                raise PlanError(
319	                    "UnknownField", f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'"
320	                )
321	            type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
322	            if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
323	                if node.selection_set is not None:
324	                    raise PlanError(
325	                        "InvalidQuery",
326	                        f"scalar field '{node.name}' must not have a selection set",
327	                    )
328	                if node.args:
329	                    raise PlanError(
330	                        "InvalidQuery",
331	                        f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
332	                    )
333	                if node_path not in entry["fields"]:
334	                    entry["fields"].append(node_path)
335	                continue
336	            target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
337	            if target is None:
338	                raise PlanError(
339	                    "UnknownField",
340	                    f"field '{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
341	                )
342	            if node.args:
343	                raise PlanError(
344	                    "InvalidQuery",
345	                    f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
346	                )
347	            if node.selection_set is None:
348	                raise PlanError(
349	                    "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
350	                )
351	            if field.link is None:
352	                raise PlanError(
353	                    "MappingError",
354	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' is missing an @link directive",
355	                )
356	            target_entity = target.entity
357	            if target_entity is None:
358	                raise PlanError(
359	                    "UnknownEntity",
360	                    f"type '{target.name}' is not mapped to an entity",
361	                )
362	            local, target_key, as_array = field.link
363	            if target_key != target_entity.key:
364	                raise PlanError(
365	                    "InvalidJoin",
366	                    f"@link target {target_key} does not match the primary key of entity '{target_entity.table}'",
367	                )
368	            self.joins.append(
369	                {
370	                    "path": node_path,
371	                    "fromEntity": entity.table,
372	                    "fromField": local if as_array else local[0],
373	                    "toEntity": target_entity.table,
374	                    "toField": target_key if as_array else target_key[0],
375	                }
376	            )
377	            self._walk(target, target_entity, node.selection_set, node_path, entry)

"""graph-index command line interface."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .complexity import (
    QueryComplexityExceeded,
    complexity_error_payload,
    enforce_complexity,
    load_limit_from_env,
)
from .errors import PlanError
from .executor import ExecContext, QueryCompiler, execute, fold_events
from .planner import Planner
from .schema import load_schema
from .subscription import SubscriptionCompiler, push_events


def _read_text_file(path: str) -> str:
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as handle:
            data = handle.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise PlanError("IoError", f"cannot read '{path}': {exc.strerror or exc}")
    try:
        return data.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise PlanError("IoError", f"'{path}' is not valid UTF-8")


def _load_variables(variables_text: str, source: str) -> dict:
    try:
        variables = json.loads(variables_text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise PlanError(
            "ParseError",
            f"{source}:{exc.lineno}:{exc.colno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}",
        )
    if not isinstance(variables, dict):
        raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"'{source}' must contain a JSON object")
    return variables


def _cmd_query_plan(args) -> dict:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    query_text = _read_text_file(args.query)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    planner = Planner(schema, variables)
    return planner.plan(query_text, args.query, args.operation)


def _cmd_subscription_push(args, complexity_limit) -> list:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    subscription_text = _read_text_file(args.subscription)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)
    events_text = _read_text_file(args.events)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    compiler = SubscriptionCompiler(
        schema, variables, bound_args_allowed=complexity_limit is not None
    )
    plan = compiler.compile(subscription_text, args.subscription, args.operation)
    if complexity_limit is not None:
        # Gate before any subscription is established or event is processed.
        enforce_complexity(
            schema,
            variables,
            subscription_text,
            args.subscription,
            args.operation,
            SubscriptionCompiler._select_operation,
            complexity_limit,
        )
    return push_events(plan, events_text, args.events)


def _cmd_query_exec(args, complexity_limit) -> dict:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    query_text = _read_text_file(args.query)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)
    events_text = _read_text_file(args.events)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    compiler = QueryCompiler(
        schema, variables, bound_args_allowed=complexity_limit is not None
    )
    _operation_name, roots = compiler.compile(
        query_text, args.query, args.operation
    )
    if complexity_limit is not None:
        # Gate after the document/variables have passed ordinary validation but
        # before any indexed entity is read (events are folded only afterwards).
        enforce_complexity(
            schema,
            variables,
            query_text,
            args.query,
            args.operation,
            QueryCompiler._select_operation,
            complexity_limit,
        )
    ctx = ExecContext(schema, compiler.entity_keys, compiler.key_types)
    # A query that only asks for introspection/meta-fields still requires the
    # events file to be readable, but its events are never parsed or folded.
    if any("response_key" in root for root in roots):
        fold_events(ctx, events_text, args.events)
    return execute(roots, ctx)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="graph-index",
        description="Blockchain data index and GraphQL query service tooling.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    query_plan = sub.add_parser(
        "query-plan", help="compile a GraphQL query into an entity scan/join plan"
    )
    query_plan.add_argument("--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)")
    query_plan.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="GraphQL query file")
    query_plan.add_argument("--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file")
    query_plan.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    subscription_push = sub.add_parser(
        "subscription-push",
        help="push entity change events matching a GraphQL subscription as JSONL",
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--subscription", required=True, help="GraphQL subscription file"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--events", required=True, help="entity change events file (NDJSON)"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    query_exec = sub.add_parser(
        "query-exec",
        help="execute a GraphQL query over entity change events",
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="GraphQL query file")
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--events", required=True, help="entity change events file (NDJSON)"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    return parser


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        # Read and validate the complexity limit at startup, before the command
        # opens anything: an invalid value fails with the unique diagnostic
        # code INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT. Absent/0 disables the control.
        complexity_limit = load_limit_from_env()
    except PlanError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(
            json.dumps({"code": exc.code, "message": exc.message}, ensure_ascii=False)
            + "\n"
        )
        return 2
    try:
        if args.command == "query-plan":
            result = _cmd_query_plan(args)
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0
        if args.command == "subscription-push":
            try:
                rows = _cmd_subscription_push(args, complexity_limit)
            except QueryComplexityExceeded as exc:
                sys.stdout.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        complexity_error_payload(exc.complexity, exc.limit),
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                        indent=2,
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )
                return 0
            for row in rows:
                sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            return 0
        if args.command == "query-exec":
            try:
                result = _cmd_query_exec(args, complexity_limit)
            except QueryComplexityExceeded as exc:
                # Deterministic stop: data is null and the single error carries
                # QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED; no resolver ran and no entity was
                # read, so the response is still a normal GraphQL success exit.
                result = complexity_error_payload(exc.complexity, exc.limit)
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0
        raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", f"unknown command '{args.command}'")
    except PlanError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(
            json.dumps({"code": exc.code, "message": exc.message}, ensure_ascii=False)
            + "\n"
        )
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
    raise SystemExit(main())

3	Compiles a query operation into per-root filters and selection trees (sharing
4	the planner's fragment, variable and @link semantics), folds an NDJSON entity
5	change stream into the current primary-key snapshot of every reachable
6	entity, then answers the query once against those snapshots.
7	
8	List roots return every matching row in first-insert order (UPDATE replaces a
9	row in place; DELETE followed by re-INSERT moves it to the end); single-object
10	roots return null on no match and fail with QueryError on more than one match.
11	Single-object @link fields follow local -> target primary key; list @link
12	fields equality-match arbitrary scalar target fields in target insert order.
13	"""
14

36	class ExecNode:
37	    """A compiled field in the query selection tree.
38	
39	    Leaf fields carry ``field_type`` and no children. Link fields also carry
40	    the validated @link mapping (local/target field names, target entity) and
41	    their compiled children; ``is_list`` selects list resolution.
42	    """
43	
44	    __slots__ = (
45	        "response_key",
46	        "field_name",
47	        "field_type",
48	        "required",
49	        "is_list",
50	        "local",
51	        "local_types",
52	        "target",
53	        "target_types",
54	        "target_table",
55	        "children",
56	        "type_name",
57	    )
58	
59	    def __init__(
60	        self,
61	        response_key: str,
62	        field_name: str,
63	        field_type=None,
64	        required: bool = False,
65	        is_list: bool = False,
66	        local: Optional[List[str]] = None,
67	        local_types: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
68	        target: Optional[List[str]] = None,
69	        target_types: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
70	        target_table: Optional[str] = None,
71	        children: Optional[List["ExecNode"]] = None,
72	        type_name: Optional[str] = None,
73	    ):
74	        self.response_key = response_key
75	        self.field_name = field_name
76	        self.field_type = field_type
77	        self.required = required
78	        self.is_list = is_list
79	        self.local = local
80	        self.local_types = local_types
81	        self.target = target
82	        self.target_types = target_types
83	        self.target_table = target_table
84	        self.children = children
85	        # Set for the implicit __typename field: the object type to report.
86	        self.type_name = type_name

89	class ExecContext:
90	    """Everything execution needs beyond the compiled roots."""
91	
92	    __slots__ = ("schema", "entity_keys", "key_types", "snapshots")
93	
94	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
95	                 key_types: Dict[str, List[Any]]):
96	        self.schema = schema
97	        self.entity_keys = entity_keys
98	        # table -> primary key field type refs, in declared order
99	        self.key_types = key_types
100	        self.snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore] = {}

103	class QueryCompiler(Planner):
104	    """Compiles a query document into one executable entry per root field."""
105	
106	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, variables: Dict[str, Any],
107	                 bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
108	        super().__init__(schema, variables, bound_args_allowed)
109	        self.entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
110	        self.key_types: Dict[str, List[Any]] = {}
111	
112	    def compile(
113	        self, query_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]
114	    ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], List[dict]]:
115	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
116	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
117	        if op.op_type != "query":
118	            raise PlanError(
119	                "UnsupportedOperation",
120	                f"{op.op_type} operations are not supported by query-exec",
121	            )
122	        self.var_map = {}
123	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
124	            if name in self.var_map:
125	                raise PlanError(
126	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once"
127	                )
128	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
129	
130	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get("query")
131	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
132	        if root_type is None:
133	            raise PlanError(
134	                "MappingError",
135	                "schema does not define a root type for query operations",
136	            )
137	
138	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
139	        if not selections:
140	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "query has an empty selection set")
141	
142	        roots: List[dict] = []
143	        self.entity_keys = {}
144	        self.key_types = {}
145	        intro = IntroCompiler(self.schema, self._resolve, self.fragments)
146	        for node in selections:
147	            key = node.alias or node.name
148	            # The implicit __typename meta-field may be selected on any object
149	            # type, including the query root; it reports the object type name.
150	            if node.name == "__typename":
151	                IntroCompiler.validate_typename(node)
152	                roots.append(
153	                    {"typename_introspection": key, "name": root_type.name}
154	                )
155	                continue
156	            # Introspection roots cost 0, never touch the entity snapshots and
157	            # are available with or without complexity control.
158	            if node.name == "__schema":
159	                tree = intro.compile_schema_root(node, key)
160	                roots.append({"schema_introspection": key, "tree": tree})
161	                continue
162	            if node.name == "__type":
163	                type_name, tree = intro.compile_type_root(node, key)
164	                roots.append(
165	                    {"type_introspection": key, "tree": tree, "name": type_name}
166	                )
167	                continue
168	            roots.append(self._compile_root(node, root_type))
169	        return op.name, roots
170	
171	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
172	
173	    @staticmethod
174	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
175	        if operation_name is not None:
176	            for op in operations:
177	                if op.name == operation_name:
178	                    return op
179	            raise PlanError("InvalidOperation", f"no operation named '{operation_name}'")
180	        if not operations:
181	            raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", "document contains no operations")
182	        if len(operations) == 1:
183	            return operations[0]
184	        raise PlanError(
185	            "InvalidRequest",
186	            "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
187	        )
188	
189	    # -- roots ------------------------------------------------------------------
190	
191	    def _compile_root(self, node, root_type: TypeInfo) -> dict:
192	        key = node.alias or node.name
193	        field = root_type.fields.get(node.name)
194	        if field is None:
195	            raise PlanError(
196	                "UnknownField",
197	                f"unknown root field '{node.name}' on type '{root_type.name}'",
198	            )
199	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
200	        target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
201	        entity = target.entity if target is not None else None
202	        if entity is None:
203	            raise PlanError(
204	                "UnknownEntity",
205	                f"root field '{node.name}' does not return a mapped entity type",
206	            )
207	        if node.selection_set is None:
208	            raise PlanError(
209	                "InvalidQuery", f"root field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
210	            )
211	        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
212	            if (
213	                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
214	                and not arg_def.has_default
215	                and arg_name not in node.args
216	            ):
217	                raise PlanError(
218	                    "UnknownField",
219	                    f"missing required argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
220	                )
221	        is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
222	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
223	        filter_types: Dict[str, Any] = {}
224	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
225	            if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
226	                # A list-size bound used for complexity; never a filter. If it
227	                # is a variable, resolve it so type/required-variable errors
228	                # are reported by the normal validation phase.
229	                if isinstance(value, Var):
230	                    self._resolve(value)
231	                continue
232	            if arg_name not in field.args:
233	                raise PlanError(
234	                    "UnknownField",
235	                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
236	                )
237	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
238	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
239	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
240	            ):
241	                raise PlanError(
242	                    "UnknownField",
243	                    f"argument '{arg_name}' does not match a filterable field of "
244	                    f"entity '{entity.table}'",
245	                )
246	            filter_obj[arg_name] = self._resolve(value)
247	            filter_types[arg_name] = target_field.type_ref
248	
249	        self.entity_keys[entity.table] = list(entity.key)
250	        self.key_types[entity.table] = [
251	            target.fields[name].type_ref for name in entity.key
252	        ]
253	        children = self._compile_fields(
254	            target, entity, node.selection_set, key
255	        )
256	        return {
257	            "response_key": key,
258	            "field_name": node.name,
259	            "table": entity.table,
260	            "filter": filter_obj,
261	            "filter_types": filter_types,
262	            "is_list": is_list,
263	            "children": children,
264	        }
265	
266	    # -- selection tree -----------------------------------------------------------
267	
268	    def _compile_fields(
269	        self,
270	        info: TypeInfo,
271	        entity: Entity,
272	        selection_set,
273	        path: str,
274	    ) -> List[ExecNode]:
275	        selections = self._expand(selection_set, info.name, [])
276	        if not selections:
277	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"empty selection set at '{path}'")
278	        children: List[ExecNode] = []
279	        seen = set()
280	        for node in selections:
281	            key = node.alias or node.name
282	            node_path = f"{path}.{key}"
283	            if node.name == "__schema" or node.name == "__type":
284	                raise PlanError(
285	                    "InvalidQuery",
286	                    f"introspection field '{node.name}' may only be selected "
287	                    f"on the root query type",
288	                )
289	            if node.name == "__typename":
290	                if node.args:
291	                    raise PlanError(
292	                        "InvalidQuery",
293	                        "field '__typename' does not take arguments",
294	                    )
295	                if node.selection_set is not None:
296	                    raise PlanError(
297	                        "InvalidQuery",
298	                        "field '__typename' must not have a selection set",
299	                    )
300	                if key not in seen:
301	                    seen.add(key)
302	                    children.append(
303	                        ExecNode(key, "__typename", STRING_TYPE,
304	                                 type_name=info.name)
305	                    )
306	                continue
307	            field = info.fields.get(node.name)
308	            if field is None:
309	                raise PlanError(
310	                    "UnknownField", f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'"
311	                )
312	            type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
313	            if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
314	                if node.selection_set is not None:
315	                    raise PlanError(
316	                        "InvalidQuery",
317	                        f"scalar field '{node.name}' must not have a selection set",
318	                    )
319	                if node.args:
320	                    raise PlanError(
321	                        "InvalidQuery",
322	                        f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
323	                    )
324	                if key not in seen:
325	                    seen.add(key)
326	                    children.append(ExecNode(key, node.name, field.type_ref))
327	                continue
328	            is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
329	            for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
330	                if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
331	                    if isinstance(value, Var):
332	                        self._resolve(value)
333	                    continue
334	                raise PlanError(
335	                    "InvalidQuery",
336	                    f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
337	                )
338	            if node.selection_set is None:
339	                raise PlanError(
340	                    "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
341	                )
342	            required = field.type_ref[0] == "non_null"
343	            if field.link is None:
344	                raise PlanError(
345	                    "MappingError",
346	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' is missing an @link directive",
347	                )
348	            target_info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
349	            if target_info is None:
350	                raise PlanError(
351	                    "MappingError",
352	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
353	                )
354	            target_entity = target_info.entity
355	            if target_entity is None:
356	                raise PlanError(
357	                    "UnknownEntity",
358	                    f"type '{target_info.name}' is not mapped to an entity",
359	                )
360	            local, target_fields, _as_array = field.link
361	            if is_list:
362	                for name in local:
363	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, info.fields.get(name)):
364	                        raise PlanError(
365	                            "MappingError",
366	                            f"@link local field '{name}' of type '{info.name}' "
367	                            f"must be a scalar",
368	                        )
369	                for name in target_fields:
370	                    matched = target_info.fields.get(name)
371	                    if matched is None:
372	                        raise PlanError(
373	                            "MappingError",
374	                            f"@link target field '{name}' is not a field of type "
375	                            f"'{target_info.name}'",
376	                        )
377	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched):
378	                        raise PlanError(
379	                            "MappingError",
380	                            f"@link target field '{name}' of type "
381	                            f"'{target_info.name}' must be a scalar",
382	                        )
383	            elif target_fields != target_entity.key:
384	                raise PlanError(
385	                    "InvalidJoin",
386	                    f"@link target {target_fields} does not match the primary key of "
387	                    f"entity '{target_entity.table}'",
388	                )
389	            nested = self._compile_fields(
390	                target_info, target_entity, node.selection_set, node_path
391	            )
392	            if key not in seen:
393	                seen.add(key)
394	                self.entity_keys[target_entity.table] = list(target_entity.key)
395	                self.key_types[target_entity.table] = [
396	                    target_info.fields[name].type_ref for name in target_entity.key
397	                ]
398	                children.append(
399	                    ExecNode(
400	                        key,
401	                        node.name,
402	                        field.type_ref,
403	                        required=required,
404	                        is_list=is_list,
405	                        local=list(local),
406	                        local_types=[info.fields[n].type_ref for n in local],
407	                        target=list(target_fields),
408	                        target_types=[
409	                            target_info.fields[n].type_ref for n in target_fields
410	                        ],
411	                        target_table=target_entity.table,
412	                        children=nested,
413	                    )
414	                )
415	        return children
416	
417	
418	def _is_scalar_value_field(schema: Schema, field) -> bool:
419	    """Whether a field holds a single (non-list) scalar value."""
420	    if field is None:
421	        return False
422	    return (
423	        not _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
424	        and named_of(field.type_ref) in schema.scalars
425	    )

429	# Event folding

431	
432	
433	def fold_events(ctx: ExecContext, events_text: str, source: str) -> None:
434	    """Parse and validate every event line, then fold them into snapshots."""
435	    events: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
436	    for lineno, raw in enumerate(events_text.splitlines(), 1):
437	        line = raw.strip()
438	        if not line:
439	            continue
440	        events.append((lineno, _parse_event(line, source, lineno)))
441	
442	    for lineno, event in events:
443	        _apply_event(ctx, event, source, lineno)
444	
445	
446	def _parse_event(line: str, source: str, lineno: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
447	    try:
448	        event = json.loads(line)
449	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
450	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}")
451	    if not isinstance(event, dict):
452	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event must be a JSON object")
453	    for key in ("op", "entity", "before", "after"):
454	        if key not in event:
455	            raise PlanError(
456	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event is missing '{key}'"
457	            )
458	    if event["op"] not in EVENT_OPS:
459	        raise PlanError(
460	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: unknown op {event['op']!r}"
461	        )
462	    if not isinstance(event["entity"], str) or not event["entity"]:
463	        raise PlanError(
464	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: 'entity' must be a non-empty string"
465	        )
466	    for key in ("before", "after"):
467	        if event[key] is not None and not isinstance(event[key], dict):
468	            raise PlanError(
469	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: '{key}' must be an object or null"
470	            )
471	    return event
472	
473	
474	def _apply_event(
475	    ctx: ExecContext, event: Dict[str, Any], source: str, lineno: int
476	) -> None:
477	    """Maintain the current snapshot store for one validated event.
478	
479	    Events for entities the query cannot reach are ignored (as in
480	    subscription-push); for every reachable entity the operative snapshot
481	    must carry a well-formed scalar primary key.
482	    """
483	    key_fields = ctx.entity_keys.get(event["entity"])
484	    if key_fields is None:
485	        return
486	    op = event["op"]
487	    if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
488	        snapshot = event["after"]
489	        if snapshot is None:
490	            raise PlanError(
491	                "EventError",
492	                f"{source}:{lineno}: {op} event requires an 'after' snapshot",
493	            )
494	        key = _require_key(
495	            key_fields, ctx.key_types[event["entity"]], snapshot,
496	            event["entity"], ctx.schema, source, lineno,
497	        )
498	        ctx.snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore()).upsert(key, snapshot)
499	        return
500	    snapshot = event["before"]
501	    if snapshot is None:
502	        raise PlanError(
503	            "EventError",
504	            f"{source}:{lineno}: DELETE event requires a 'before' snapshot",
505	        )
506	    key = _require_key(
507	        key_fields, ctx.key_types[event["entity"]], snapshot,
508	        event["entity"], ctx.schema, source, lineno,
509	    )
510	    ctx.snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore()).delete(key)
511	
512	
513	def _require_key(
514	    key_fields: List[str],
515	    key_types: List[Any],
516	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
517	    table: str,
518	    schema: Schema,
519	    source: str,
520	    lineno: int,
521	) -> Tuple[Any, ...]:
522	    """Build a primary-key tuple, rejecting any malformed or incomplete one."""
523	    values: List[Any] = []
524	    for name, type_ref in zip(key_fields, key_types):
525	        if name not in snapshot:
526	            raise PlanError(
527	                "EventError",
528	                f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot of entity '{table}' is missing "
529	                f"primary key field '{name}'",
530	            )
531	        value = snapshot[name]
532	        if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
533	            raise PlanError(
534	                "EventError",
535	                f"{source}:{lineno}: primary key field '{name}' of entity '{table}' "
536	                f"cannot be null or a composite value",
537	            )
538	        _check_value_shape(schema, type_ref, value, f"{table}.{name}")
539	        values.append(value)
540	    return tuple(values)

543	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
544	# Query execution
545	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
546	
547	
548	def execute(roots: List[dict], ctx: ExecContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
549	    """Answer the compiled query against the current snapshot stores."""
550	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
551	    for root in roots:
552	        if "typename_introspection" in root:
553	            data[root["typename_introspection"]] = root["name"]
554	            continue
555	        if "schema_introspection" in root:
556	            data[root["schema_introspection"]] = render_schema_root(
557	                root["tree"], ctx.schema
558	            )
559	            continue
560	        if "type_introspection" in root:
561	            data[root["type_introspection"]] = render_type_root(
562	                root["tree"], root["name"], ctx.schema
563	            )
564	            continue
565	        data[root["response_key"]] = _execute_root(root, ctx)
566	    return {"data": data}
567	
568	
569	def _execute_root(root: dict, ctx: ExecContext) -> Any:
570	    store = ctx.snapshots.get(root["table"])
571	    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
572	    if store is not None:
573	        for row in store.values():
574	            if _matches_filter(root, row, ctx):
575	                rows.append(row)
576	    path = root["response_key"]
577	    if root["is_list"]:
578	        return [_project(root["children"], row, ctx, path) for row in rows]
579	    if not rows:
580	        return None
581	    if len(rows) > 1:
582	        raise PlanError(
583	            "QueryError",
584	            f"single-object root field '{path}' matched {len(rows)} entities",
585	        )
586	    return _project(root["children"], rows[0], ctx, path)
587	
588	
589	def _matches_filter(root: dict, snapshot: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext) -> bool:
590	    for name, expected in root["filter"].items():
591	        if name not in snapshot:
592	            raise PlanError(
593	                "EventError",
594	                f"snapshot of entity '{root['table']}' is missing filter field "
595	                f"'{name}'",
596	            )
597	        value = snapshot[name]
598	        _check_value_shape(
599	            ctx.schema,
600	            root["filter_types"][name],
601	            value,
602	            f"{root['response_key']}({name})",
603	        )
604	        if value != expected:
605	            return False
606	    return True
607	
608	
609	def _project(
610	    nodes: List[ExecNode],
611	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
612	    ctx: ExecContext,
613	    path: str,
614	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
615	    """Project compiled selections over one entity snapshot."""
616	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
617	    for node in nodes:
618	        node_path = f"{path}.{node.response_key}"
619	        if node.field_name == "__typename":
620	            data[node.response_key] = node.type_name
621	            continue
622	        if node.children is None:
623	            if node.field_name not in snapshot:
624	                raise PlanError(
625	                    "EventError",
626	                    f"snapshot is missing field '{node.field_name}' for '{node_path}'",
627	                )
628	            value = snapshot[node.field_name]
629	            _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, node.field_type, value, node_path)
630	            data[node.response_key] = value
631	            continue
632	        if node.is_list:
633	            data[node.response_key] = _project_list(node, snapshot, ctx, node_path)
634	            continue
635	        related = _resolve_object(node, snapshot, ctx, node_path)
636	        if related is None:
637	            if node.required:
638	                raise PlanError(
639	                    "EventError",
640	                    f"non-null relationship '{node_path}' resolved to null",
641	                )
642	            data[node.response_key] = None
643	        else:
644	            data[node.response_key] = _project(
645	                node.children, related, ctx, node_path
646	            )

648	
649	
650	def _project_list(
651	    node: ExecNode,
652	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
653	    ctx: ExecContext,
654	    path: str,
655	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
656	    matches = _resolve_list(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
657	    return [_project(node.children, related, ctx, path) for related in matches]

659	
660	# -- @link resolution -----------------------------------------------------------
661	
662	
663	def _read_local(
664	    node: ExecNode, snapshot: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext, path: str
665	) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
666	    """Read @link local values; None means any local value is null."""
667	    local_values: List[Any] = []
668	    for name, type_ref in zip(node.local, node.local_types):
669	        if name not in snapshot:
670	            raise PlanError(
671	                "EventError",
672	                f"snapshot is missing local key field '{name}' for '{path}'",
673	            )
674	        value = snapshot[name]
675	        if value is None:
676	            return None
677	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
678	            raise PlanError(
679	                "EventError",
680	                f"local key field '{name}' for '{path}' cannot form a scalar key",
681	            )
682	        _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
683	        local_values.append(value)
684	    return local_values
685	
686	
687	def _check_target_fields(
688	    node: ExecNode, related: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext, path: str
689	) -> None:
690	    """Ensure every matched target field is present with a compatible scalar."""
691	    for name, type_ref in zip(node.target, node.target_types):
692	        if name not in related:
693	            raise PlanError(
694	                "EventError",
695	                f"target snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' is missing key "
696	                f"field '{name}' for '{path}'",
697	            )
698	        value = related[name]
699	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
700	            raise PlanError(
701	                "EventError",
702	                f"target key field '{name}' for '{path}' cannot be matched as a "
703	                f"scalar",
704	            )
705	        if value is not None:
706	            _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
707	
708	
709	def _check_primary_key(node: ExecNode, ctx: ExecContext, related: Dict[str, Any],
710	                       path: str) -> None:
711	    """Ensure a matched target snapshot supplies a well-formed primary key."""
712	    key_fields = ctx.entity_keys[node.target_table]
713	    key_types = ctx.key_types[node.target_table]
714	    for name, type_ref in zip(key_fields, key_types):
715	        if name not in related:
716	            raise PlanError(
717	                "EventError",
718	                f"target snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' for '{path}' is "
719	                f"missing primary key field '{name}'",
720	            )
721	        value = related[name]
722	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)) or value is None:
723	            raise PlanError(
724	                "EventError",
725	                f"primary key field '{name}' of entity '{node.target_table}' for "
726	                f"'{path}' cannot be a key",
727	            )
728	        _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
729	
730	
731	def _resolve_object(
732	    node: ExecNode,
733	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
734	    ctx: ExecContext,
735	    path: str,
736	) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
737	    """Follow a single-object @link to the unique current target snapshot."""
738	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
739	    if local_values is None:
740	        return None
741	
742	    target_store = ctx.snapshots.get(node.target_table)
743	    related = (
744	        _MISSING
745	        if target_store is None
746	        else target_store.rows.get(tuple(local_values), _MISSING)
747	    )
748	    if related is _MISSING:
749	        rendered = ", ".join(
750	            f"{name}: {json.dumps(value)}"
751	            for name, value in zip(node.target, local_values)
752	        )
753	        raise PlanError(
754	            "EventError",
755	            f"no current snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' for '{path}' "
756	            f"with key {{{rendered}}}",
757	        )
758	    _check_target_fields(node, related, ctx, path)
759	    return related
760	
761	
762	def _resolve_list(
763	    node: ExecNode,
764	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
765	    ctx: ExecContext,
766	    path: str,
767	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
768	    """Match all current target snapshots for a list @link, in insert order.
769	
770	    An empty list stands for both an absent relationship (any local value
771	    null) and one without a current match.
772	    """
773	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
774	    if local_values is None:
775	        return []
776	
777	    target_store = ctx.snapshots.get(node.target_table)
778	    if target_store is None:
779	        return []
780	    expected = tuple(local_values)
781	    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
782	    for related in target_store.values():
783	        _check_target_fields(node, related, ctx, path)
784	        values = tuple(related[name] for name in node.target)
785	        if values != expected or None in values:
786	            continue
787	        _check_primary_key(node, ctx, related, path)
788	        matches.append(related)
789	    return matches
790	
791	
792	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
793	# Scalar / enum / list shape validation against the schema
794	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
795	
796	
797	def _check_value_shape(
798	    schema: Schema, type_ref, value: Any, path: str
799	) -> None:
800	    """Validate a snapshot value against a field's declared shape.
801	
802	    A null value is accepted for nullable positions and rejected for
803	    non-null ones; lists must be JSON arrays (elements checked recursively,
804	    honoring their own non-null wrappers) and leaf values must belong to the
805	    declared scalar/enum primitive family.
806	    """
807	    non_null = type_ref[0] == "non_null"
808	    if non_null:
809	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
810	    if value is None:
811	        if non_null:
812	            raise PlanError(
813	                "EventError", f"non-null field '{path}' resolved to null"
814	            )
815	        return
816	    if type_ref[0] == "list":
817	        if not isinstance(value, list):
818	            raise PlanError(
819	                "EventError",
820	                f"field '{path}' expects a list but the snapshot value is not an array",
821	            )
822	        for item in value:
823	            _check_value_shape(schema, type_ref[1], item, path)
824	        return
825	    name = type_ref[1]
826	    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
827	        raise PlanError(
828	            "EventError", f"field '{path}' cannot hold a composite value"
829	        )
830	    if name == "Int":
831	        if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
832	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects an Int value")
833	    elif name == "Float":
834	        if not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or isinstance(value, bool):
835	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a Float value")
836	    elif name == "String":
837	        if not isinstance(value, str):
838	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a String value")
839	    elif name == "ID":
840	        if not (
841	            isinstance(value, str)
842	            or (isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool))
843	        ):
844	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects an ID value")
845	    elif name == "Boolean":
846	        if not isinstance(value, bool):
847	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a Boolean value")
848	    elif name in schema.enums:
849	        if not isinstance(value, str):
850	            raise PlanError(
851	                "EventError", f"enum field '{path}' expects a string enum value"
852	            )
853	    # Other custom scalar names accept any scalar JSON value.

1	"""Query complexity control.
2	
3	Computes a deterministic request-complexity score from the same GraphQL
4	document and variables used by execution, strictly *before* any resolver,
5	indexed-entity read or subscription is established. Over-limit requests stop
6	with a single ``QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED`` GraphQL error without touching the
7	entity snapshots.
8	
9	Scoring rules
10	-------------
11	* the selected operation is walked from its root selection set;
12	* every leaf field costs 1; a composite field costs only the sum of its
13	  children (the object container itself is free);
14	* repeated fields and distinct aliases are scored independently;
15	* fragments are inlined once at each spread position; an inline fragment
16	  contributes its selection directly;
17	* introspection fields ``__schema`` and ``__type`` cost 0;
18	* list fields scale their sub-selection by an effective item upper bound read
19	  from a ``first`` or ``limit`` argument -- a literal positive integer first,
20	  then a positive-integer variable of the same name -- falling back to
21	  ``DEFAULT_LIST_BOUND`` when the argument is absent, non-positive or
22	  non-integer. Variable values keep their GraphQL type validation from the
23	  existing validation phase; the scorer never rejects one (a non-integer bound
24	  simply means "no usable bound").
25	
26	The scorer walks the raw AST rather than the planner's merged selection so the
27	"repeated fields count separately" requirement holds regardless of the
28	response-key de-duplication execution performs.
29	"""
30	
31	from __future__ import annotations
32	
33	import os
34	from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional
35	
36	from .errors import PlanError
37	from .gql import (
38	    FieldNode,
39	    FragmentSpread,
40	    InlineFragment,
41	    Var,
42	    parse_executable,
43	)
44	from .planner import Planner, _is_list_type
45	from .schema import Schema, TypeInfo, named_of
46	
47	DEFAULT_LIST_BOUND = 1000
48	LIMIT_ENV_VAR = "GRAPHQL_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT"
49	
50	# Argument names that may supply a list item upper bound, in priority order.
51	BOUND_ARG_NAMES = ("first", "limit")
52	
53	
54	class QueryComplexityExceeded(PlanError):
55	    """The selected operation scores strictly above the configured limit.
56	
57	    Rendered as a GraphQL response on stdout (``data: null`` plus a single
58	    error whose ``extensions.code`` is QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED) rather than
59	    the usual ``{code, message}`` stderr envelope.
60	    """
61	
62	    def __init__(self, complexity: int, limit: int):
63	        super().__init__(
64	            "QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED",
65	            f"query complexity {complexity} exceeds the configured limit {limit}",
66	        )
67	        self.complexity = complexity
68	        self.limit = limit
69	
70	
71	def complexity_error_payload(complexity: int, limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
72	    """Build the GraphQL-style response emitted for an over-limit request."""
73	    return {
74	        "data": None,
75	        "errors": [
76	            {
77	                "message": (
78	                    f"query complexity {complexity} exceeds the configured "
79	                    f"limit {limit}"
80	                ),
81	                "extensions": {"code": "QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED"},
82	            }
83	        ],
84	    }
85	
86	
87	def load_complexity_limit(raw: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
88	    """Validate a GRAPHQL_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT value.
89	
90	    Returns ``None`` when the control is disabled (the variable is unset or
91	    ``"0"``), otherwise the positive integer limit. A negative, non-integer or
92	    otherwise unparseable value raises INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT.
93	    """
94	    if raw is None:
95	        return None
96	    text = raw.strip()
97	    try:
98	        value = int(text)
99	    except ValueError:
100	        raise PlanError(
101	            "INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT",
102	            f"value {raw!r} must be a non-negative integer",
103	        )
104	    if value < 0:
105	        raise PlanError(
106	            "INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT",
107	            "query complexity limit must not be negative",
108	        )
109	    if value == 0:
110	        return None
111	    return value
112	
113	
114	def load_limit_from_env(
115	    environ: Optional[Dict[str, Optional[str]]] = None,
116	) -> Optional[int]:
117	    """Read and validate the limit from the process environment."""
118	    env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
119	    return load_complexity_limit(env.get(LIMIT_ENV_VAR))
120	
121	
122	class ComplexityCalculator(Planner):
123	    """Scores one selected operation using the planner's type knowledge.
124	
125	    Only fragment type-condition matching is inherited; the selection walk is
126	    intentionally separate so it never merges repeated fields.
127	    """
128	
129	    def score_operation(self, op, fragments: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
130	        self.fragments = fragments
131	        self.var_map = {}
132	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
133	            if name in self.var_map:
134	                raise PlanError(
135	                    "VariablesError",
136	                    f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once",
137	                )
138	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
139	
140	        root_name = self.schema.roots.get(op.op_type)
141	        root_info = self.schema.types.get(root_name) if root_name else None
142	        if root_info is None:
143	            raise PlanError(
144	                "UnknownField",
145	                f"schema does not define a root type for {op.op_type} operations",
146	            )
147	        return self._walk_set(op.selection_set, root_info, [])
148	
149	    # -- list bounds ----------------------------------------------------------
150	
151	    def _resolve_bound(self, value: Any) -> Optional[int]:
152	        """Resolve a first/limit argument to a positive integer, else None."""
153	        if isinstance(value, Var):
154	            spec = self.var_map.get(value.name)
155	            if spec is None:
156	                # An undeclared variable is reported by the regular validation
157	                # phase; complexity treats it as "no usable bound".
158	                return None
159	            _type_ref, default, has_default = spec
160	            if value.name in self.variables:
161	                value = self.variables[value.name]
162	            elif has_default:
163	                value = default
164	            else:
165	                return None
166	        if isinstance(value, bool):
167	            return None
168	        if isinstance(value, int) and value > 0:
169	            return value
170	        return None
171	
172	    def _bound_for(self, node: FieldNode) -> int:
173	        """Effective item upper bound for a list field."""
174	        for arg_name in BOUND_ARG_NAMES:
175	            if arg_name in node.args:
176	                bound = self._resolve_bound(node.args[arg_name])
177	                return bound if bound is not None else DEFAULT_LIST_BOUND
178	        return DEFAULT_LIST_BOUND
179	
180	    # -- selection walk -------------------------------------------------------
181	
182	    def _walk_set(self, selections, info: TypeInfo, stack: List[str]) -> int:
183	        return sum(self._walk_one(sel, info, stack) for sel in selections)
184	
185	    def _walk_one(self, sel, info: TypeInfo, stack: List[str]) -> int:
186	        if isinstance(sel, FieldNode):
187	            return self._walk_field(sel, info, stack)
188	        if isinstance(sel, FragmentSpread):
189	            frag = self.fragments.get(sel.name)
190	            if frag is None:
191	                raise PlanError(
192	                    "InvalidQuery", f"unknown fragment '{sel.name}'"
193	                )
194	            if sel.name in stack:
195	                raise PlanError(
196	                    "InvalidQuery", f"fragment cycle involving '{sel.name}'"
197	                )
198	            if not self._type_condition_matches(frag.type_condition, info.name):
199	                return 0
200	            frag_info = self.schema.types.get(frag.type_condition, info)
201	            return self._walk_set(
202	                frag.selection_set, frag_info, stack + [sel.name]
203	            )
204	        if isinstance(sel, InlineFragment):
205	            if sel.type_condition is None:
206	                return self._walk_set(sel.selection_set, info, stack)
207	            if not self._type_condition_matches(sel.type_condition, info.name):
208	                return 0
209	            inner_info = self.schema.types.get(sel.type_condition, info)
210	            return self._walk_set(sel.selection_set, inner_info, stack)
211	        return 0
212	
213	    def _walk_field(self, node: FieldNode, info: TypeInfo, stack: List[str]) -> int:
214	        # Introspection fields and the implicit __typename field always cost 0,
215	        # including their sub-selections; they are available whether or not
216	        # complexity control is enabled.
217	        if node.name in ("__schema", "__type", "__typename"):
218	            return 0
219	        field = info.fields.get(node.name)
220	        if field is None:
221	            raise PlanError(
222	                "UnknownField",
223	                f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'",
224	            )
225	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
226	        if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
227	            return 1
228	        target_info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
229	        if target_info is None:
230	            raise PlanError(
231	                "UnknownField",
232	                f"field '{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
233	            )
234	        if node.selection_set is None:
235	            raise PlanError(
236	                "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
237	            )
238	        inner = self._walk_set(node.selection_set, target_info, stack)
239	        if _is_list_type(field.type_ref):
240	            inner *= self._bound_for(node)
241	        return inner
242	
243	
244	def enforce_complexity(
245	    schema: Schema,
246	    variables: Dict[str, Any],
247	    query_text: str,
248	    source: str,
249	    operation_name: Optional[str],
250	    select_operation: Callable,
251	    limit: int,
252	) -> int:
253	    """Re-parse the document, select the operation and enforce the limit.
254	
255	    Invoked only after the command's own compiler has validated the document,
256	    so any GraphQL/variable/mapping error has already surfaced with its
257	    existing code. Raises QueryComplexityExceeded when the score is strictly
258	    above ``limit``; returns the score otherwise.
259	    """
260	    operations, fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
261	    op = select_operation(operations, operation_name)
262	    calculator = ComplexityCalculator(schema, variables)
263	    complexity = calculator.score_operation(op, fragments)
264	    if complexity > limit:
265	        raise QueryComplexityExceeded(complexity, limit)
266	    return complexity

1	"""Schema model: object types plus the @entity / @link mapping directives.
2	
3	Mapping declaration problems (missing or conflicting entity/directive
4	declarations, dangling type references) raise PlanError "MappingError".
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
10	
11	from .errors import PlanError
12	from .gql import Directive, TypeRef, parse_schema_document
13	
14	BUILTIN_SCALARS = frozenset({"Int", "Float", "String", "Boolean", "ID"})
15	BUILTIN_SCALAR_ORDER = ("Int", "Float", "String", "Boolean", "ID")
16	
17	
18	def named_of(type_ref: TypeRef) -> str:
19	    """Unwrap list/non-null wrappers down to the named type."""
20	    while type_ref[0] in ("list", "non_null"):
21	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
22	    return type_ref[1]
23	
24	
25	class Entity:
26	    __slots__ = ("type_name", "table", "key")
27	
28	    def __init__(self, type_name: str, table: str, key: List[str]):
29	        self.type_name = type_name
30	        self.table = table
31	        self.key = key  # primary key field names, in declared order
32	
33	
34	class FieldInfo:
35	    __slots__ = ("name", "type_ref", "args", "link_directives", "link")
36	
37	    def __init__(self, name, type_ref, args, link_directives):
38	        self.name = name
39	        self.type_ref = type_ref
40	        self.args = args  # Dict[str, InputValueDef]
41	        self.link_directives = link_directives
42	        # (local names, target names, declared_as_arrays) once validated
43	        self.link: Optional[Tuple[List[str], List[str], bool]] = None
44	
45	
46	class TypeInfo:
47	    __slots__ = ("name", "fields", "interfaces", "entity")
48	
49	    def __init__(self, name: str, interfaces: Optional[List[str]] = None):
50	        self.name = name
51	        self.fields: Dict[str, FieldInfo] = {}
52	        self.interfaces: List[str] = interfaces if interfaces is not None else []
53	        self.entity: Optional[Entity] = None
54	
55	
56	class DirectiveInfo:
57	    __slots__ = ("name", "args", "repeatable", "locations")
58	
59	    def __init__(self, name, args, repeatable, locations):
60	        self.name = name
61	        self.args: Dict[str, object] = args
62	        self.repeatable = repeatable
63	        self.locations = locations
64	
65	
66	class Schema:
67	    def __init__(self):
68	        self.types: Dict[str, TypeInfo] = {}
69	        self.scalars = set(BUILTIN_SCALARS)
70	        self.scalar_order: List[str] = list(BUILTIN_SCALAR_ORDER)
71	        self.enums = set()
72	        self.enum_values: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
73	        self.inputs: Dict[str, Dict[str, object]] = {}
74	        self.interfaces = set()
75	        self.interface_types: Dict[str, TypeInfo] = {}
76	        self.directives: Dict[str, DirectiveInfo] = {}
77	        self.directive_order: List[str] = []
78	        self.unions: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
79	        self.roots: Dict[str, str] = {}  # "query" | "mutation" | "subscription" -> type name
80	
81	    def is_leaf(self, type_name: str) -> bool:
82	        return type_name in self.scalars or type_name in self.enums
83	
84	    def known_type(self, type_name: str) -> bool:
85	        return (
86	            type_name in self.scalars
87	            or type_name in self.enums
88	            or type_name in self.types
89	            or type_name in self.inputs
90	            or type_name in self.interfaces
91	            or type_name in self.unions
92	        )
93	
94	
95	def _mapping_error(message: str) -> PlanError:
96	    return PlanError("MappingError", message)
97	
98	
99	def load_schema(text: str, source: str = "<schema>") -> Schema:
100	    doc = parse_schema_document(text, source)
101	    schema = Schema()
102	    schema.scalars |= set(doc.scalars)
103	    schema.scalar_order.extend(doc.scalars)
104	    schema.enums = {enum_def.name for enum_def in doc.enums}
105	    schema.enum_values = {
106	        enum_def.name: list(enum_def.values) for enum_def in doc.enums
107	    }
108	    schema.interfaces = {tdef.name for tdef in doc.interfaces}
109	    schema.unions = dict(doc.unions)
110	
111	    for directive_def in doc.directives:
112	        if directive_def.name in schema.directives:
113	            raise _mapping_error(
114	                f"duplicate directive definition '@{directive_def.name}'"

220	def _normalize_field_list(value, what: str) -> Tuple[List[str], bool]:
221	    """Normalize a string-or-string-array directive argument.
222	
223	    Returns (field names in declared order, declared_as_array). Anything
224	    else (empty arrays, non-string elements, duplicates, other types) is a
225	    MappingError.
226	    """
227	    if isinstance(value, str):
228	        if not value:
229	            raise _mapping_error(f"{what} requires a non-empty string")
230	        return [value], False
231	    if isinstance(value, list):
232	        if not value:
233	            raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must not be an empty array")
234	        names: List[str] = []
235	        for item in value:
236	            if not isinstance(item, str) or not item:
237	                raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must contain only non-empty strings")
238	            if item in names:
239	                raise _mapping_error(f"{what} contains duplicate field '{item}'")
240	            names.append(item)

242	    raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must be a string or an array of strings")

245	def _build_entity(schema: Schema, info: TypeInfo, directive: Directive) -> Entity:
246	    table = directive.args.get("name")
247	    if not isinstance(table, str) or not table:
248	        raise _mapping_error(f"@entity on '{info.name}' requires a non-empty string 'name'")
249	    key, _ = _normalize_field_list(
250	        directive.args.get("key"), f"@entity 'key' of type '{info.name}'"
251	    )
252	    for name in key:
253	        key_field = info.fields.get(name)
254	        if key_field is None:
255	            raise _mapping_error(f"@entity key '{name}' is not a field of type '{info.name}'")
256	        if named_of(key_field.type_ref) not in schema.scalars:
257	            raise _mapping_error(f"@entity key '{name}' of type '{info.name}' must be a scalar")

261	def _validate_type_references(schema: Schema) -> None:
262	    def check(type_ref: TypeRef, where: str) -> None:
263	        name = named_of(type_ref)
264	        if not schema.known_type(name):
265	            raise _mapping_error(f"unknown type '{name}' referenced by {where}")
266	
267	    for info in schema.types.values():
268	        for field in info.fields.values():
269	            check(field.type_ref, f"'{info.name}.{field.name}'")
270	            for arg in field.args.values():
271	                check(arg.type, f"argument '{arg.name}' of '{info.name}.{field.name}'")
272	    for input_name, fields in schema.inputs.items():
273	        for fdef in fields.values():
274	            check(fdef.type, f"input field '{input_name}.{fdef.name}'")
275	    for union_name, members in schema.unions.items():
276	        for member in members:
277	            if member not in schema.types:
278	                raise _mapping_error(f"union '{union_name}' references unknown type '{member}'")

281	def _validate_links(schema: Schema) -> None:
282	    for info in schema.types.values():
283	        for field in info.fields.values():
284	            directives = field.link_directives
285	            if len(directives) > 1:
286	                raise _mapping_error(f"field '{info.name}.{field.name}' has multiple @link directives")

291	            local, local_is_array = _normalize_field_list(
292	                directive.args.get("local"), f"{where} argument 'local'"
293	            )
294	            target, target_is_array = _normalize_field_list(

296	            )
297	            if local_is_array != target_is_array:
298	                raise _mapping_error(

300	                )
301	            if len(local) != len(target):

329	def _validate_entity_tables(schema: Schema) -> None:
330	    tables: Dict[str, str] = {}
