342	def _resolve_roots(schema: Schema, declared: Dict[str, str]) -> None:
343	    for op, default_name in (("query", "Query"), ("mutation", "Mutation"), ("subscription", "Subscription")):

1	"""Subscription push: match entity change events against a subscription.
2	
3	Compiles a subscription operation into an equality filter plus a field
4	projection over a single @entity root, then applies it to an NDJSON stream of
5	entity change events. GraphQL, variable and @entity mapping semantics are
6	shared with the query planner; the supported selection shape covers leaf
7	fields, nested object fields and nested list fields reached through @link
8	joins (one or more levels deep, including aliases and fragment spreads).
9	
10	List fields match every current target snapshot whose @link target field
11	values equal the source's local field values; the matched targets are
12	recursively projected in target insert order. The @link target of a list
13	relationship need not be (part of) the target entity's primary key.
14	
15	Every event line is parsed and validated before the first snapshot changes.
16	Besides a root entity's own INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (pushed only while the
17	snapshot matches the filter), an event on any entity reachable through the
18	selected @link tree pushes a synthetic UPDATE for each still-matching root
19	whose projected shape changed when the event was applied.
20	"""
21	
22	from __future__ import annotations
23	
24	import json
25	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
26	
27	from .errors import PlanError
28	from .gql import Var, parse_executable
29	from .planner import Planner, _is_list_type
30	from .schema import Entity, TypeInfo, named_of
31	
32	EVENT_OPS = ("INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE")
33	
34	_MISSING = object()
35	
36	
37	class SubscriptionPlan:
38	    """A compiled subscription ready to filter and project event snapshots."""
39	
40	    __slots__ = (
41	        "operation_name",
42	        "path",
43	        "entity_table",
44	        "entity_keys",
45	        "filter",
46	        "tree",
47	    )
48	
49	    def __init__(
50	        self,
51	        operation_name: Optional[str],
52	        path: str,
53	        entity_table: str,
54	        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
55	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any],
56	        tree: "LinkedField",
57	    ):
58	        self.operation_name = operation_name
59	        self.path = path
60	        self.entity_table = entity_table
61	        # entity table -> primary key field names, in declared order, for the
62	        # root entity and every entity reachable through selected @link fields
63	        self.entity_keys = entity_keys
64	        self.filter = filter_obj  # entity field name -> expected value
65	        self.tree = tree  # compiled selection tree rooted at the root field
66	
67	    def matches(self, snapshot: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
68	        for name, expected in self.filter.items():
69	            if name not in snapshot:
70	                raise PlanError(
71	                    "EventError", f"snapshot is missing filter field '{name}'"
72	                )
73	            if snapshot[name] != expected:
74	                return False
75	        return True

77	
78	class LinkedField:
79	    """A compiled field in the subscription selection tree.
80	
81	    Leaf fields carry ``field_name`` and no children. Link fields carry the
82	    validated @link mapping (local/target field names, target entity) and a
83	    list of compiled children; ``is_list`` selects list (ordered, possibly
84	    many) rather than single-object resolution.
85	    """
86	
87	    __slots__ = (
88	        "response_key",
89	        "field_name",
90	        "required",
91	        "is_list",
92	        "local",
93	        "target",
94	        "target_table",
95	        "children",
96	    )
97	
98	    def __init__(
99	        self,
100	        response_key: str,
101	        field_name: str,
102	        required: bool = False,
103	        is_list: bool = False,
104	        local: Optional[List[str]] = None,
105	        target: Optional[List[str]] = None,
106	        target_table: Optional[str] = None,
107	        children: Optional[List["LinkedField"]] = None,
108	    ):
109	        self.response_key = response_key
110	        self.field_name = field_name
111	        self.required = required  # field declared as a non-null object type
112	        self.is_list = is_list
113	        self.local = local  # source-side key field names, in @link order
114	        self.target = target  # target-side matched field names, in @link order
115	        self.target_table = target_table
116	        self.children = children

119	class SubscriptionCompiler(Planner):
120	    """Reuses the planner's fragment expansion and variable resolution."""
121	
122	    def __init__(self, schema, variables, bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
123	        super().__init__(schema, variables, bound_args_allowed)
124	
125	    def compile(
126	        self, subscription_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]
127	    ) -> SubscriptionPlan:
128	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(subscription_text, source)
129	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
130	        self.var_map = {}
131	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
132	            if name in self.var_map:
133	                raise PlanError(
134	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once"
135	                )
136	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
137	
138	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get("subscription")
139	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
140	        if root_type is None:
141	            raise PlanError(
142	                "MappingError",
143	                "schema does not define a root type for subscription operations",
144	            )
145	
146	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
147	        if not selections:
148	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "subscription has an empty selection set")
149	        if len(selections) != 1:
150	            raise PlanError(
151	                "InvalidQuery", "subscription must select exactly one root field"
152	            )
153	        node = selections[0]
154	        key = node.alias or node.name
155	
156	        field = root_type.fields.get(node.name)
157	        if field is None:
158	            raise PlanError(
159	                "InvalidQuery",
160	                f"unknown root field '{node.name}' on type '{root_type.name}'",
161	            )
162	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
163	        target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
164	        entity = target.entity if target is not None else None
165	        if entity is None:
166	            raise PlanError(
167	                "MappingError",
168	                f"root field '{node.name}' does not return a mapped entity type",
169	            )
170	        if node.selection_set is None:
171	            raise PlanError(
172	                "InvalidQuery", f"root field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
173	            )
174	
175	        filter_obj = self._compile_filter(field, target, entity.table, node)
176	        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]] = {entity.table: list(entity.key)}
177	        children = self._compile_fields(
178	            target, entity, node.selection_set, key, entity_keys
179	        )
180	        tree = LinkedField(key, key, children=children)
181	        return SubscriptionPlan(
182	            op.name, key, entity.table, entity_keys, filter_obj, tree
183	        )

185	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
186	
187	    @staticmethod
188	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
189	        if operation_name is not None:
190	            for op in operations:
191	                if op.name == operation_name and op.op_type == "subscription":
192	                    return op
193	            raise PlanError(
194	                "InvalidQuery", f"no subscription named '{operation_name}'"
195	            )
196	        if not operations:
197	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "document contains no operations")
198	        if len(operations) != 1:

200	                "InvalidQuery",
201	                "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
202	            )
203	        op = operations[0]

208	    # -- filter ------------------------------------------------------------------
209	
210	    def _compile_filter(self, field, target, table, node) -> Dict[str, Any]:
211	        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
212	            if (
213	                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
214	                and not arg_def.has_default
215	                and arg_name not in node.args
216	            ):
217	                raise PlanError(
218	                    "InvalidQuery",

221	        is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)

223	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
224	            if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):

231	            if arg_name not in field.args:

233	                    "InvalidQuery",

235	                )
236	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
237	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
238	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
239	            ):
240	                raise PlanError(
241	                    "InvalidQuery",

247	    # -- selection tree -----------------------------------------------------------
248	
249	    def _compile_fields(
250	        self,

341	                        raise PlanError(
342	                            "MappingError",
343	                            f"@link target field '{name}' of type "
344	                            f"'{target_info.name}' must be a scalar",
345	                        )
346	            elif target_key != target_entity.key:
347	                raise PlanError(
348	                    "InvalidJoin",
349	                    f"@link target {target_key} does not match the primary key of "
350	                    f"entity '{target_entity.table}'",
351	                )
352	            nested = self._compile_fields(
353	                target_info,
354	                target_entity,
355	                node.selection_set,
356	                node_path,
357	                entity_keys,
358	            )
359	            if key not in seen:
360	                seen.add(key)
361	                entity_keys[target_entity.table] = list(target_entity.key)
362	                children.append(
363	                    LinkedField(
364	                        key,
365	                        node.name,
366	                        required=required,
367	                        is_list=is_list,
368	                        local=list(local),
369	                        target=list(target_key),
370	                        target_table=target_entity.table,
371	                        children=nested,
372	                    )
373	                )
374	        return children
375

377	def _is_scalar_value_field(schema, field) -> bool:
378	    """Whether a field holds a single (non-list) built-in/custom scalar."""
379	    if field is None:
380	        return False
381	    return (
382	        not _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
383	        and named_of(field.type_ref) in schema.scalars
384	    )

387	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
388	# Event processing
389	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
390	
391	
392	class _OrderedStore:
393	    """Latest snapshots of one entity, kept in insert order.
394	
395	    INSERT introduces a new row at the end; UPDATE replaces a row in place and
396	    preserves its position; DELETE removes a row, so a later re-INSERT is
397	    appended at the end again. Snapshots whose primary key cannot be built
398	    cannot participate in keyed identity (and therefore cannot be deleted by
399	    key); they are retained separately so a list match on non-key target
400	    fields can surface them as an EventError instead of silently dropping them.
401	    """
402	
403	    __slots__ = ("rows", "keyless")
404	
405	    def __init__(self):
406	        self.rows: Dict[Tuple[Any, ...], Dict[str, Any]] = {}
407	        self.keyless: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
408	
409	    def upsert(self, key: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]], snapshot: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
410	        # Dict assignment appends a new key at the end and replaces an existing
411	        # key's value without moving it, which is exactly the required order.
412	        if key is None:
413	            self.keyless.append(snapshot)
414	        else:
415	            self.rows[key] = snapshot
416	
417	    def delete(self, key: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]]) -> None:
418	        # A keyed row is removed so a later upsert re-appends it at the end; a
419	        # keyless DELETE cannot identify a stored row and leaves them untouched.
420	        if key is not None:
421	            self.rows.pop(key, None)
422	
423	    def values(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
424	        return list(self.rows.values())
425	
426	
427	def push_events(
428	    plan: SubscriptionPlan, events_text: str, source: str
429	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
430	    """Apply a compiled subscription to an NDJSON event stream, in order.
431	
432	    Every line is parsed and validated first; the latest snapshot of each
433	    entity is then maintained by primary key, and matching root events are
434	    projected against the snapshots known up to and including that line.
435	
436	    An event on an entity reachable through the selected @link tree also
437	    pushes a synthetic UPDATE for every root that still matches the filter
438	    after the event and whose projected shape changed; the affected roots are
439	    reported in their current snapshot insert order.
440	    """
441	    events: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
442	    for lineno, raw in enumerate(events_text.splitlines(), 1):
443	        line = raw.strip()
444	        if not line:
445	            continue
446	        events.append((lineno, _parse_event(line, source, lineno)))
447	
448	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore] = {}
449	    outputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
450	    for lineno, event in events:
451	        # Events on entities the selection tree cannot reach stay read-only:
452	        # they neither change a store nor get to test a relationship.
453	        if event["entity"] not in plan.entity_keys:
454	            continue
455	        # Project every currently matching root against pre-event snapshots so
456	        # the post-event comparison can tell an actual projection change from
457	        # noise. This runs before the store mutates, so a malformed line ends
458	        # the stream without partial output.
459	        before_rows = _root_rows(plan, snapshots)
460	        before_shapes: Dict[Any, Any] = {}
461	        for identity, snapshot in before_rows:
462	            if plan.matches(snapshot):
463	                before_shapes[identity] = _project(
464	                    plan.tree.children,
465	                    snapshot,
466	                    snapshots,
467	                    plan.entity_keys,
468	                    source,
469	                    lineno,
470	                    plan.path,
471	                )
472	        _apply_event(plan.entity_keys, snapshots, event)
473	        excluded: Optional[set] = None
474	        if event["entity"] == plan.entity_table:
475	            direct_identity = _direct_identity(plan, snapshots, event)
476	            excluded = {direct_identity}
477	            output = _push_root_event(
478	                plan, event, snapshots, source, lineno
479	            )
480	            if output is not None:
481	                outputs.append(output)
482	        outputs.extend(
483	            _push_dependency_changes(
484	                plan,
485	                snapshots,
486	                source,
487	                lineno,
488	                before_shapes,
489	                excluded,
490	            )
491	        )
492	    return outputs
493	
494	
495	def _root_rows(
496	    plan: SubscriptionPlan, snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore]
497	) -> List[Tuple[Any, Dict[str, Any]]]:
498	    """Current root snapshots in stable insert order with an identity key.
499	
500	    Keyed rows use their primary-key tuple; keyless rows use their stored
501	    object identity so an UPDATE that appends another keyless snapshot is not
502	    mistaken for the same root.
503	    """
504	    store = snapshots.get(plan.entity_table)
505	    if store is None:
506	        return []
507	    key_fields = plan.entity_keys[plan.entity_table]
508	    rows: List[Tuple[Any, Dict[str, Any]]] = [
509	        (_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot), snapshot)
510	        for snapshot in store.rows.values()
511	    ]
512	    rows.extend((id(snapshot), snapshot) for snapshot in store.keyless)
513	    return rows
514	
515	
516	def _direct_identity(
517	    plan: SubscriptionPlan,
518	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
519	    event: Dict[str, Any],
520	) -> Any:
521	    """Store identity of the row a root entity event directly targets."""
522	    op = event["op"]
523	    snapshot = event["after"] if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE") else event["before"]
524	    key = _key_tuple(plan.entity_keys[plan.entity_table], snapshot)
525	    if key is not None:
526	        return key
527	    if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
528	        store = snapshots.get(plan.entity_table)
529	        if store is not None:
530	            for keyless in store.keyless:
531	                if keyless is snapshot:
532	                    return id(keyless)
533	    return id(snapshot)
534	
535	
536	def _push_root_event(
537	    plan: SubscriptionPlan,
538	    event: Dict[str, Any],
539	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
540	    source: str,
541	    lineno: int,
542	) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
543	    """Emit the direct record for a root entity INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.
544	
545	    Returns the record, or None when the operative snapshot does not match
546	    the filter. Root events keep their original behavior even when the root
547	    table is also reachable through a self-referential @link.
548	    """
549	    op = event["op"]
550	    snapshot = event["after"] if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE") else event["before"]
551	    if snapshot is None:
552	        raise PlanError(
553	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: {op} event has no snapshot"
554	        )
555	    if not plan.matches(snapshot):
556	        return None
557	    data = _project(
558	        plan.tree.children,
559	        snapshot,
560	        snapshots,
561	        plan.entity_keys,
562	        source,
563	        lineno,
564	        plan.path,
565	    )
566	    return {
567	        "subscription": plan.operation_name,
568	        "path": plan.path,
569	        "event": op,
570	        "entity": event["entity"],
571	        "data": data,
572	    }
573	
574	
575	def _push_dependency_changes(
576	    plan: SubscriptionPlan,
577	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
578	    source: str,
579	    lineno: int,
580	    before_shapes: Dict[Any, Any],
581	    excluded: Optional[set],
582	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
583	    """Append synthetic UPDATEs for roots whose projected shape changed.
584	
585	    Only roots present both before and after the event, still matching the
586	    filter and not carrying their own direct record for this line qualify;
587	    they are reported in the current stable root insert order.
588	    """
589	    outputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
590	    for identity, snapshot in _root_rows(plan, snapshots):
591	        if excluded is not None and identity in excluded:
592	            continue
593	        if identity not in before_shapes or not plan.matches(snapshot):
594	            continue
595	        data = _project(
596	            plan.tree.children,
597	            snapshot,
598	            snapshots,
599	            plan.entity_keys,
600	            source,
601	            lineno,
602	            plan.path,
603	        )
604	        if before_shapes[identity] == data:
605	            continue
606	        outputs.append(
607	            {
608	                "subscription": plan.operation_name,
609	                "path": plan.path,
610	                "event": "UPDATE",
611	                "entity": plan.entity_table,
612	                "data": data,
613	            }
614	        )
615	    return outputs
616	
617	
618	def _apply_event(
619	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
620	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
621	    event: Dict[str, Any],
622	) -> None:
623	    """Update the latest-snapshot store for one validated event.
624	
625	    Events for entities the subscription cannot reach are ignored. Rows whose
626	    snapshot lacks a usable primary key cannot identify an entity; they are
627	    retained separately so a list match on non-key target fields can surface
628	    them as an EventError instead of silently dropping them.
629	    """
630	    key_fields = entity_keys.get(event["entity"])
631	    if key_fields is None:
632	        return
633	    store = snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore())
634	    if event["op"] in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
635	        snapshot = event["after"]
636	        if snapshot is not None:
637	            store.upsert(_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot), snapshot)
638	        return
639	    snapshot = event["before"]
640	    if snapshot is not None:
641	        store.delete(_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot))
642	
643	
644	def _key_tuple(
645	    key_fields: List[str], snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
646	) -> Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]]:
647	    """Build a primary-key tuple, or None when the snapshot cannot supply one."""
648	    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
649	        return None
650	    values: List[Any] = []
651	    for name in key_fields:
652	        value = snapshot.get(name)
653	        if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
654	            return None
655	        values.append(value)
656	    return tuple(values)
657	
658	
659	def _project(
660	    nodes: List[LinkedField],
661	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
662	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
663	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
664	    source: str,
665	    lineno: int,
666	    path: str,
667	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
668	    """Project compiled selections over one entity snapshot."""
669	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
670	    for node in nodes:
671	        node_path = f"{path}.{node.response_key}"
672	        if node.children is None:
673	            if node.field_name not in snapshot:
674	                raise PlanError(
675	                    "EventError",
676	                    f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot is missing field "
677	                    f"'{node.field_name}'",
678	                )
679	            data[node.response_key] = snapshot[node.field_name]
680	            continue
681	        if node.is_list:
682	            data[node.response_key] = _project_list(
683	                node, snapshot, snapshots, entity_keys, source, lineno, node_path
684	            )
685	            continue
686	        related = _resolve_object(node, snapshot, snapshots, source, lineno, node_path)
687	        if related is None:
688	            if node.required:
689	                raise PlanError(
690	                    "EventError",
691	                    f"{source}:{lineno}: non-null relationship '{node_path}' "
692	                    f"resolved to null",
693	                )
694	            data[node.response_key] = None
695	        else:
696	            data[node.response_key] = _project(
697	                node.children,
698	                related,
699	                snapshots,
700	                entity_keys,
701	                source,
702	                lineno,
703	                node_path,
704	            )
705	    return data
706	
707	
708	def _project_list(
709	    node: LinkedField,
710	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
711	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
712	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
713	    source: str,
714	    lineno: int,
715	    path: str,
716	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
717	    """Resolve a list @link and project each matched target snapshot."""
718	    matches = _resolve_list(
719	        node, snapshot, snapshots, entity_keys, source, lineno, path
720	    )
721	    return [
722	        _project(
723	            node.children,
724	            related,
725	            snapshots,
726	            entity_keys,
727	            source,
728	            lineno,
729	            path,
730	        )
731	        for related in matches
732	    ]
733

735	def _read_local(
736	    node: LinkedField,
737	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
738	    source: str,
739	    lineno: int,
740	    path: str,
741	) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
742	    """Read the @link local key values from a source snapshot.
743	
744	    Returns None when any local value is null (the relationship itself is
745	    absent). Missing local key fields or values that cannot form a scalar key
746	    end the stream with EventError.
747	    """
748	    local_values: List[Any] = []
749	    for name in node.local:
750	        if name not in snapshot:
751	            raise PlanError(
752	                "EventError",
753	                f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot is missing local key field "
754	                f"'{name}' for '{path}'",
755	            )
756	        value = snapshot[name]
757	        if value is None:
758	            return None
759	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
760	            raise PlanError(
761	                "EventError",
762	                f"{source}:{lineno}: local key field '{name}' for '{path}' "
763	                f"cannot form a scalar key",
764	            )
765	        local_values.append(value)
766	    return local_values
767

769	def _check_target_fields(
770	    node: LinkedField,
771	    related: Dict[str, Any],
772	    source: str,
773	    lineno: int,
774	    path: str,
775	) -> None:
776	    """Ensure every matched target field is present (and scalar) on a snapshot."""
777	    for name in node.target:
778	        if name not in related:
779	            raise PlanError(
780	                "EventError",
781	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target snapshot is missing key field "
782	                f"'{name}' for '{path}'",
783	            )
784	        if isinstance(related[name], (dict, list)):
785	            raise PlanError(
786	                "EventError",
787	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target key field '{name}' for '{path}' "
788	                f"cannot be matched as a scalar",
789	            )

792	def _check_primary_key(
793	    table: str,
794	    key_fields: List[str],
795	    related: Dict[str, Any],
796	    source: str,
797	    lineno: int,
798	    path: str,
799	) -> None:
800	    """Ensure a matched target snapshot supplies its scalar primary key."""
801	    for name in key_fields:
802	        if name not in related:
803	            raise PlanError(
804	                "EventError",
805	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target snapshot of entity '{table}' for "
806	                f"'{path}' is missing primary key field '{name}'",
807	            )
808	        if isinstance(related[name], (dict, list)):
809	            raise PlanError(
810	                "EventError",
811	                f"{source}:{lineno}: primary key field '{name}' of entity "
812	                f"'{table}' for '{path}' cannot be a key",
813	            )
814	
815	
816	def _resolve_object(
817	    node: LinkedField,
818	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
819	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
820	    source: str,
821	    lineno: int,
822	    path: str,
823	) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
824	    """Follow one single-object @link to the latest target snapshot.
825	
826	    Returns None when any local key value is null (the relationship itself is
827	    absent). Missing local key fields, values that cannot form the target
828	    primary key or a target key without a current snapshot end the stream with
829	    EventError.
830	    """
831	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, source, lineno, path)
832	    if local_values is None:
833	        return None
834	
835	    target_store = snapshots.get(node.target_table)
836	    related = (
837	        _MISSING
838	        if target_store is None
839	        else target_store.rows.get(tuple(local_values), _MISSING)
840	    )
841	    if related is _MISSING:
842	        rendered = ", ".join(
843	            f"{name}: {json.dumps(value)}"
844	            for name, value in zip(node.target, local_values)
845	        )
846	        raise PlanError(
847	            "EventError",
848	            f"{source}:{lineno}: no current snapshot of entity "
849	            f"'{node.target_table}' for '{path}' with key {{{rendered}}}",
850	        )
851	    _check_target_fields(node, related, source, lineno, path)
852	    return related
853	
854	
855	def _resolve_list(
856	    node: LinkedField,
857	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
858	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
859	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
860	    source: str,
861	    lineno: int,
862	    path: str,
863	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
864	    """Match all current target snapshots for a list @link, in insert order.
865	
866	    An empty list stands for both an absent relationship (any local value
867	    null) and a relationship without a current match. Local key fields that
868	    are missing or non-scalar, and matched target snapshots that lack a target
869	    field or a usable primary key, end the stream with EventError.
870	    """
871	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, source, lineno, path)
872	    if local_values is None:
873	        return []
874	
875	    target_store = snapshots.get(node.target_table)
876	    if target_store is None:
877	        return []
878	    pk_fields = entity_keys[node.target_table]
879	    expected = tuple(local_values)
880	    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
881	    candidates = list(target_store.rows.values()) + list(target_store.keyless)
882	    for related in candidates:
883	        _check_target_fields(node, related, source, lineno, path)
884	        values = tuple(related[name] for name in node.target)
885	        if values != expected or None in values:
886	            continue
887	        _check_primary_key(
888	            node.target_table, pk_fields, related, source, lineno, path
889	        )
890	        matches.append(related)
891	    return matches
892	
893	
894	def _parse_event(line: str, source: str, lineno: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
895	    try:
896	        event = json.loads(line)
897	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
898	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}")
899	    if not isinstance(event, dict):
900	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event must be a JSON object")
901	    for key in ("op", "entity", "before", "after"):
902	        if key not in event:
903	            raise PlanError(
904	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event is missing '{key}'"
905	            )
906	    if event["op"] not in EVENT_OPS:
907	        raise PlanError(
908	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: unknown op {event['op']!r}"
909	        )
910	    if not isinstance(event["entity"], str):
911	        raise PlanError(
912	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: 'entity' must be a string"
913	        )
914	    for key in ("before", "after"):
915	        if event[key] is not None and not isinstance(event[key], dict):
916	            raise PlanError(
917	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: '{key}' must be an object or null"
918	            )
919	    return event

"""Subscription push: match entity change events against a subscription.

Compiles a subscription operation into an equality filter plus a field
projection over a single @entity root, then applies it to an NDJSON stream of
entity change events. GraphQL, variable and @entity mapping semantics are
shared with the query planner; the supported selection shape covers leaf
fields, nested object fields and nested list fields reached through @link
joins (one or more levels deep, including aliases and fragment spreads).

List fields match every current target snapshot whose @link target field
values equal the source's local field values; the matched targets are
recursively projected in target insert order. The @link target of a list
relationship need not be (part of) the target entity's primary key.

Every event line is parsed and validated before the first snapshot changes.
Besides a root entity's own INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (pushed only while the
snapshot matches the filter), an event on any entity reachable through the
selected @link tree pushes a synthetic UPDATE for each still-matching root
whose projected shape changed when the event was applied.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from .errors import PlanError
from .gql import Var, parse_executable
from .planner import Planner, _is_list_type
from .schema import Entity, TypeInfo, named_of

EVENT_OPS = ("INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE")

_MISSING = object()


class SubscriptionPlan:
    """A compiled subscription ready to filter and project event snapshots."""

    __slots__ = (
        "operation_name",
        "path",
        "entity_table",
        "entity_keys",
        "filter",
        "tree",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        operation_name: Optional[str],
        path: str,
        entity_table: str,
        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any],
        tree: "LinkedField",
    ):
        self.operation_name = operation_name
        self.path = path
        self.entity_table = entity_table
        # entity table -> primary key field names, in declared order, for the
        # root entity and every entity reachable through selected @link fields
        self.entity_keys = entity_keys
        self.filter = filter_obj  # entity field name -> expected value
        self.tree = tree  # compiled selection tree rooted at the root field

    def matches(self, snapshot: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        for name, expected in self.filter.items():
            if name not in snapshot:
                raise PlanError(
                    "EventError", f"snapshot is missing filter field '{name}'"
                )
            if snapshot[name] != expected:
                return False
        return True


class LinkedField:
    """A compiled field in the subscription selection tree.

    Leaf fields carry ``field_name`` and no children. Link fields carry the
    validated @link mapping (local/target field names, target entity) and a
    list of compiled children; ``is_list`` selects list (ordered, possibly
    many) rather than single-object resolution.
    """

    __slots__ = (
        "response_key",
        "field_name",
        "required",
        "is_list",
        "local",
        "target",
        "target_table",
        "children",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        response_key: str,
        field_name: str,
        required: bool = False,
        is_list: bool = False,
        local: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        target: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        target_table: Optional[str] = None,
        children: Optional[List["LinkedField"]] = None,
    ):
        self.response_key = response_key
        self.field_name = field_name
        self.required = required  # field declared as a non-null object type
        self.is_list = is_list
        self.local = local  # source-side key field names, in @link order
        self.target = target  # target-side matched field names, in @link order
        self.target_table = target_table
        self.children = children


class SubscriptionCompiler(Planner):
    """Reuses the planner's fragment expansion and variable resolution."""

    def __init__(self, schema, variables, bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
        super().__init__(schema, variables, bound_args_allowed)

    def compile(
        self, subscription_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]
    ) -> SubscriptionPlan:
        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(subscription_text, source)
        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
        self.var_map = {}
        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
            if name in self.var_map:
                raise PlanError(
                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once"
                )
            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)

        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get("subscription")
        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
        if root_type is None:
            raise PlanError(
                "MappingError",
                "schema does not define a root type for subscription operations",
            )

        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
        if not selections:
            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "subscription has an empty selection set")
        if len(selections) != 1:
            raise PlanError(
                "InvalidQuery", "subscription must select exactly one root field"
            )
        node = selections[0]
        key = node.alias or node.name

        field = root_type.fields.get(node.name)
        if field is None:
            raise PlanError(
                "InvalidQuery",
                f"unknown root field '{node.name}' on type '{root_type.name}'",
            )
        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
        target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
        entity = target.entity if target is not None else None
        if entity is None:
            raise PlanError(
                "MappingError",
                f"root field '{node.name}' does not return a mapped entity type",
            )
        if node.selection_set is None:
            raise PlanError(
                "InvalidQuery", f"root field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
            )

        filter_obj = self._compile_filter(field, target, entity.table, node)
        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]] = {entity.table: list(entity.key)}
        children = self._compile_fields(
            target, entity, node.selection_set, key, entity_keys
        )
        tree = LinkedField(key, key, children=children)
        return SubscriptionPlan(
            op.name, key, entity.table, entity_keys, filter_obj, tree
        )

    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------

    @staticmethod
    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
        if operation_name is not None:
            for op in operations:
                if op.name == operation_name and op.op_type == "subscription":
                    return op
            raise PlanError(
                "InvalidQuery", f"no subscription named '{operation_name}'"
            )
        if not operations:
            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "document contains no operations")
        if len(operations) != 1:
            raise PlanError(
                "InvalidQuery",
                "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
            )
        op = operations[0]
        if op.op_type != "subscription":
            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "operation must be a subscription")
        return op

    # -- filter ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _compile_filter(self, field, target, table, node) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
            if (
                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
                and not arg_def.has_default
                and arg_name not in node.args
            ):
                raise PlanError(
                    "InvalidQuery",
                    f"missing required argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
                )
        is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
            if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
                # A list-size bound used for complexity; never a filter. If it
                # is a variable, resolve it so type/required-variable errors
                # are reported by the normal validation phase.
                if isinstance(value, Var):
                    self._resolve(value)
                continue
            if arg_name not in field.args:
                raise PlanError(
                    "InvalidQuery",
                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
                )
            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
            ):
                raise PlanError(
                    "InvalidQuery",
                    f"argument '{arg_name}' does not match a filterable field of entity '{table}'",
                )
            filter_obj[arg_name] = self._resolve(value)
        return filter_obj

    # -- selection tree -----------------------------------------------------------

    def _compile_fields(
        self,
        info: TypeInfo,
        entity: Entity,
        selection_set,
        path: str,
        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
    ) -> List[LinkedField]:
        selections = self._expand(selection_set, info.name, [])
        if not selections:
            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"empty selection set at '{path}'")
        children: List[LinkedField] = []
        seen = set()
        for node in selections:
            key = node.alias or node.name
            node_path = f"{path}.{key}"
            field = info.fields.get(node.name)
            if field is None:
                raise PlanError(
                    "InvalidQuery",
                    f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'",
                )
            type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
            if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
                if node.selection_set is not None:
                    raise PlanError(
                        "InvalidQuery",
                        f"scalar field '{node.name}' must not have a selection set",
                    )
                if node.args:
                    raise PlanError(
                        "InvalidQuery",
                        f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
                    )
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    children.append(LinkedField(key, node.name))
                continue
            is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
            for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
                if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
                    if isinstance(value, Var):
                        self._resolve(value)
                    continue
                raise PlanError(
                    "InvalidQuery",
                    f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
                )
            if node.selection_set is None:
                raise PlanError(
                    "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
                )
            required = field.type_ref[0] == "non_null"
            if field.link is None:
                raise PlanError(
                    "MappingError",
                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' is missing an @link directive",
                )
            target_info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
            if target_info is None:
                raise PlanError(
                    "MappingError",
                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
                )
            target_entity = target_info.entity
            if target_entity is None:
                raise PlanError(
                    "UnknownEntity",
                    f"type '{target_info.name}' is not mapped to an entity",
                )
            local, target_key, _as_array = field.link
            if is_list:
                # A list relationship matches equality on arbitrary scalar
                # target fields (they need not form the target primary key),
                # so every matched field must hold a single scalar value.
                for name in local:
                    matched_local = info.fields.get(name)
                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched_local):
                        raise PlanError(
                            "MappingError",
                            f"@link local field '{name}' of type '{info.name}' "
                            f"must be a scalar",
                        )
                for name in target_key:
                    matched = target_info.fields.get(name)
                    if matched is None:
                        raise PlanError(
                            "MappingError",
                            f"@link target field '{name}' is not a field of type "
                            f"'{target_info.name}'",
                        )
                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched):
                        raise PlanError(
                            "MappingError",
                            f"@link target field '{name}' of type "
                            f"'{target_info.name}' must be a scalar",
                        )
            elif target_key != target_entity.key:
                raise PlanError(
                    "InvalidJoin",
                    f"@link target {target_key} does not match the primary key of "
                    f"entity '{target_entity.table}'",
                )
            nested = self._compile_fields(
                target_info,
                target_entity,
                node.selection_set,
                node_path,
                entity_keys,
            )
            if key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                entity_keys[target_entity.table] = list(target_entity.key)
                children.append(
                    LinkedField(
                        key,
                        node.name,
                        required=required,
                        is_list=is_list,
                        local=list(local),
                        target=list(target_key),
                        target_table=target_entity.table,
                        children=nested,
                    )
                )
        return children


def _is_scalar_value_field(schema, field) -> bool:
    """Whether a field holds a single (non-list) built-in/custom scalar."""
    if field is None:
        return False
    return (
        not _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
        and named_of(field.type_ref) in schema.scalars
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event processing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class _OrderedStore:
    """Latest snapshots of one entity, kept in insert order.

    INSERT introduces a new row at the end; UPDATE replaces a row in place and
    preserves its position; DELETE removes a row, so a later re-INSERT is
    appended at the end again. Snapshots whose primary key cannot be built
    cannot participate in keyed identity (and therefore cannot be deleted by
    key); they are retained separately so a list match on non-key target
    fields can surface them as an EventError instead of silently dropping them.
    """

    __slots__ = ("rows", "keyless")

    def __init__(self):
        self.rows: Dict[Tuple[Any, ...], Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.keyless: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def upsert(self, key: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]], snapshot: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        # Dict assignment appends a new key at the end and replaces an existing
        # key's value without moving it, which is exactly the required order.
        if key is None:
            self.keyless.append(snapshot)
        else:
            self.rows[key] = snapshot

    def delete(self, key: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]]) -> None:
        # A keyed row is removed so a later upsert re-appends it at the end; a
        # keyless DELETE cannot identify a stored row and leaves them untouched.
        if key is not None:
            self.rows.pop(key, None)

    def values(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return list(self.rows.values())


def push_events(
    plan: SubscriptionPlan, events_text: str, source: str
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Apply a compiled subscription to an NDJSON event stream, in order.

    Every line is parsed and validated first; the latest snapshot of each
    entity is then maintained by primary key, and matching root events are
    projected against the snapshots known up to and including that line.

    An event on an entity reachable through the selected @link tree also
    pushes a synthetic UPDATE for every root that still matches the filter
    after the event and whose projected shape changed; the affected roots are
    reported in their current snapshot insert order.
    """
    events: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for lineno, raw in enumerate(events_text.splitlines(), 1):
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        events.append((lineno, _parse_event(line, source, lineno)))

    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore] = {}
    outputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for lineno, event in events:
        # Events on entities the selection tree cannot reach stay read-only:
        # they neither change a store nor get to test a relationship.
        if event["entity"] not in plan.entity_keys:
            continue
        # Project every currently matching root against pre-event snapshots so
        # the post-event comparison can tell an actual projection change from
        # noise. This runs before the store mutates, so a malformed line ends
        # the stream without partial output.
        before_rows = _root_rows(plan, snapshots)
        before_shapes: Dict[Any, Any] = {}
        for identity, snapshot in before_rows:
            if plan.matches(snapshot):
                before_shapes[identity] = _project(
                    plan.tree.children,
                    snapshot,
                    snapshots,
                    plan.entity_keys,
                    source,
                    lineno,
                    plan.path,
                )
        _apply_event(plan.entity_keys, snapshots, event)
        excluded: Optional[set] = None
        if event["entity"] == plan.entity_table:
            direct_identity = _direct_identity(plan, snapshots, event)
            excluded = {direct_identity}
            output = _push_root_event(
                plan, event, snapshots, source, lineno
            )
            if output is not None:
                outputs.append(output)
        outputs.extend(
            _push_dependency_changes(
                plan,
                snapshots,
                source,
                lineno,
                before_shapes,
                excluded,
            )
        )
    return outputs


def _root_rows(
    plan: SubscriptionPlan, snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore]
) -> List[Tuple[Any, Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Current root snapshots in stable insert order with an identity key.

    Keyed rows use their primary-key tuple; keyless rows use their stored
    object identity so an UPDATE that appends another keyless snapshot is not
    mistaken for the same root.
    """
    store = snapshots.get(plan.entity_table)
    if store is None:
        return []
    key_fields = plan.entity_keys[plan.entity_table]
    rows: List[Tuple[Any, Dict[str, Any]]] = [
        (_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot), snapshot)
        for snapshot in store.rows.values()
    ]
    rows.extend((id(snapshot), snapshot) for snapshot in store.keyless)
    return rows


def _direct_identity(
    plan: SubscriptionPlan,
    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
    event: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Any:
    """Store identity of the row a root entity event directly targets."""
    op = event["op"]
    snapshot = event["after"] if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE") else event["before"]
    key = _key_tuple(plan.entity_keys[plan.entity_table], snapshot)
    if key is not None:
        return key
    if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
        store = snapshots.get(plan.entity_table)
        if store is not None:
            for keyless in store.keyless:
                if keyless is snapshot:
                    return id(keyless)
    return id(snapshot)


def _push_root_event(
    plan: SubscriptionPlan,
    event: Dict[str, Any],
    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Emit the direct record for a root entity INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.

    Returns the record, or None when the operative snapshot does not match
    the filter. Root events keep their original behavior even when the root
    table is also reachable through a self-referential @link.
    """
    op = event["op"]
    snapshot = event["after"] if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE") else event["before"]
    if snapshot is None:
        raise PlanError(
            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: {op} event has no snapshot"
        )
    if not plan.matches(snapshot):
        return None
    data = _project(
        plan.tree.children,
        snapshot,
        snapshots,
        plan.entity_keys,
        source,
        lineno,
        plan.path,
    )
    return {
        "subscription": plan.operation_name,
        "path": plan.path,
        "event": op,
        "entity": event["entity"],
        "data": data,
    }


def _push_dependency_changes(
    plan: SubscriptionPlan,
    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
    before_shapes: Dict[Any, Any],
    excluded: Optional[set],
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Append synthetic UPDATEs for roots whose projected shape changed.

    Only roots present both before and after the event, still matching the
    filter and not carrying their own direct record for this line qualify;
    they are reported in the current stable root insert order.
    """
    outputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for identity, snapshot in _root_rows(plan, snapshots):
        if excluded is not None and identity in excluded:
            continue
        if identity not in before_shapes or not plan.matches(snapshot):
            continue
        data = _project(
            plan.tree.children,
            snapshot,
            snapshots,
            plan.entity_keys,
            source,
            lineno,
            plan.path,
        )
        if before_shapes[identity] == data:
            continue
        outputs.append(
            {
                "subscription": plan.operation_name,
                "path": plan.path,
                "event": "UPDATE",
                "entity": plan.entity_table,
                "data": data,
            }
        )
    return outputs


def _apply_event(
    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
    event: Dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    """Update the latest-snapshot store for one validated event.

    Events for entities the subscription cannot reach are ignored. Rows whose
    snapshot lacks a usable primary key cannot identify an entity; they are
    retained separately so a list match on non-key target fields can surface
    them as an EventError instead of silently dropping them.
    """
    key_fields = entity_keys.get(event["entity"])
    if key_fields is None:
        return
    store = snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore())
    if event["op"] in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
        snapshot = event["after"]
        if snapshot is not None:
            store.upsert(_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot), snapshot)
        return
    snapshot = event["before"]
    if snapshot is not None:
        store.delete(_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot))


def _key_tuple(
    key_fields: List[str], snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
) -> Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]]:
    """Build a primary-key tuple, or None when the snapshot cannot supply one."""
    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
        return None
    values: List[Any] = []
    for name in key_fields:
        value = snapshot.get(name)
        if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
            return None
        values.append(value)
    return tuple(values)


def _project(
    nodes: List[LinkedField],
    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
    path: str,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Project compiled selections over one entity snapshot."""
    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    for node in nodes:
        node_path = f"{path}.{node.response_key}"
        if node.children is None:
            if node.field_name not in snapshot:
                raise PlanError(
                    "EventError",
                    f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot is missing field "
                    f"'{node.field_name}'",
                )
            data[node.response_key] = snapshot[node.field_name]
            continue
        if node.is_list:
            data[node.response_key] = _project_list(
                node, snapshot, snapshots, entity_keys, source, lineno, node_path
            )
            continue
        related = _resolve_object(node, snapshot, snapshots, source, lineno, node_path)
        if related is None:
            if node.required:
                raise PlanError(
                    "EventError",
                    f"{source}:{lineno}: non-null relationship '{node_path}' "
                    f"resolved to null",
                )
            data[node.response_key] = None
        else:
            data[node.response_key] = _project(
                node.children,
                related,
                snapshots,
                entity_keys,
                source,
                lineno,
                node_path,
            )
    return data


def _project_list(
    node: LinkedField,
    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
    path: str,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Resolve a list @link and project each matched target snapshot."""
    matches = _resolve_list(
        node, snapshot, snapshots, entity_keys, source, lineno, path
    )
    return [
        _project(
            node.children,
            related,
            snapshots,
            entity_keys,
            source,
            lineno,
            path,
        )
        for related in matches
    ]


def _read_local(
    node: LinkedField,
    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
    path: str,
) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
    """Read the @link local key values from a source snapshot.

    Returns None when any local value is null (the relationship itself is
    absent). Missing local key fields or values that cannot form a scalar key
    end the stream with EventError.
    """
    local_values: List[Any] = []
    for name in node.local:
        if name not in snapshot:
            raise PlanError(
                "EventError",
                f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot is missing local key field "
                f"'{name}' for '{path}'",
            )
        value = snapshot[name]
        if value is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
            raise PlanError(
                "EventError",
                f"{source}:{lineno}: local key field '{name}' for '{path}' "
                f"cannot form a scalar key",
            )
        local_values.append(value)
    return local_values


def _check_target_fields(
    node: LinkedField,
    related: Dict[str, Any],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
    path: str,
) -> None:
    """Ensure every matched target field is present (and scalar) on a snapshot."""
    for name in node.target:
        if name not in related:
            raise PlanError(
                "EventError",
                f"{source}:{lineno}: target snapshot is missing key field "
                f"'{name}' for '{path}'",
            )
        if isinstance(related[name], (dict, list)):
            raise PlanError(
                "EventError",
                f"{source}:{lineno}: target key field '{name}' for '{path}' "
                f"cannot be matched as a scalar",
            )


def _check_primary_key(
    table: str,
    key_fields: List[str],
    related: Dict[str, Any],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
    path: str,
) -> None:
    """Ensure a matched target snapshot supplies its scalar primary key."""
    for name in key_fields:
        if name not in related:
            raise PlanError(
                "EventError",
                f"{source}:{lineno}: target snapshot of entity '{table}' for "
                f"'{path}' is missing primary key field '{name}'",
            )
        if isinstance(related[name], (dict, list)):
            raise PlanError(
                "EventError",
                f"{source}:{lineno}: primary key field '{name}' of entity "
                f"'{table}' for '{path}' cannot be a key",
            )


def _resolve_object(
    node: LinkedField,
    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
    path: str,
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Follow one single-object @link to the latest target snapshot.

    Returns None when any local key value is null (the relationship itself is
    absent). Missing local key fields, values that cannot form the target
    primary key or a target key without a current snapshot end the stream with
    EventError.
    """
    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, source, lineno, path)
    if local_values is None:
        return None

    target_store = snapshots.get(node.target_table)
    related = (
        _MISSING
        if target_store is None
        else target_store.rows.get(tuple(local_values), _MISSING)
    )
    if related is _MISSING:
        rendered = ", ".join(
            f"{name}: {json.dumps(value)}"
            for name, value in zip(node.target, local_values)
        )
        raise PlanError(
            "EventError",
            f"{source}:{lineno}: no current snapshot of entity "
            f"'{node.target_table}' for '{path}' with key {{{rendered}}}",
        )
    _check_target_fields(node, related, source, lineno, path)
    return related


def _resolve_list(
    node: LinkedField,
    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
    source: str,
    lineno: int,
    path: str,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Match all current target snapshots for a list @link, in insert order.

    An empty list stands for both an absent relationship (any local value
    null) and a relationship without a current match. Local key fields that
    are missing or non-scalar, and matched target snapshots that lack a target
    field or a usable primary key, end the stream with EventError.
    """
    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, source, lineno, path)
    if local_values is None:
        return []

    target_store = snapshots.get(node.target_table)
    if target_store is None:
        return []
    pk_fields = entity_keys[node.target_table]
    expected = tuple(local_values)
    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    candidates = list(target_store.rows.values()) + list(target_store.keyless)
    for related in candidates:
        _check_target_fields(node, related, source, lineno, path)
        values = tuple(related[name] for name in node.target)
        if values != expected or None in values:
            continue
        _check_primary_key(
            node.target_table, pk_fields, related, source, lineno, path
        )
        matches.append(related)
    return matches


def _parse_event(line: str, source: str, lineno: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        event = json.loads(line)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}")
    if not isinstance(event, dict):
        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event must be a JSON object")
    for key in ("op", "entity", "before", "after"):
        if key not in event:
            raise PlanError(
                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event is missing '{key}'"
            )
    if event["op"] not in EVENT_OPS:
        raise PlanError(
            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: unknown op {event['op']!r}"
        )
    if not isinstance(event["entity"], str):
        raise PlanError(
            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: 'entity' must be a string"
        )
    for key in ("before", "after"):
        if event[key] is not None and not isinstance(event[key], dict):
            raise PlanError(
                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: '{key}' must be an object or null"
            )
    return event

159	            i += 1

176	            i += 1

199	            else:
200	                j = i + 1
201	                buf = []
202	                closed = False
203	                while j < n:
204	                    c = text[j]
205	                    if c == '"':

208	                    if c == "\n":
209	                        error("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
210	                    if c == "\\":
211	                        esc = text[j + 1] if j + 1 < n else ""
212	                        simple = {
213	                            '"': '"',
214	                            "\\": "\\",
215	                            "/": "/",
216	                            "b": "\b",
217	                            "f": "\f",
218	                            "n": "\n",
219	                            "r": "\r",
220	                            "t": "\t",
221	                        }

223	                            hexs = text[j + 2 : j + 6]
224	                            if len(hexs) < 4 or any(

241	                tokens.append(Token("string", "".join(buf), start_line, start_col))
242	                i = j + 1
243	            newlines = segment.count("\n")

250	        if ch == "-" or ch.isdigit():

254	            sval = m.group(0)

282	        self.pos = 0
283	
284	    def peek(self) -> Token:
285	        return self.tokens[self.pos]
286	
287	    def error(self, message: str) -> "PlanError":
288	        tok = self.peek()

290	
291	    def describe(self) -> str:
292	        tok = self.peek()
293	        if tok.kind == "eof":

296	
297	    def advance(self) -> Token:
298	        tok = self.tokens[self.pos]

302	
303	    def at_punct(self, p: str) -> bool:
304	        tok = self.peek()
305	        return tok.kind == "punct" and tok.value == p
306	
307	    def eat_punct(self, p: str) -> bool:
308	        if self.at_punct(p):

310	            return True
311	        return False
312	
313	    def expect_punct(self, p: str) -> None:
314	        if not self.eat_punct(p):
315	            self.error(f"expected '{p}', found {self.describe()}")
316	
317	    def at_name(self, name: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
318	        tok = self.peek()

320	
321	    def expect_name(self) -> str:
322	        tok = self.peek()

328	    # -- types ---------------------------------------------------------------
329	
330	    def parse_type_ref(self) -> TypeRef:
331	        if self.eat_punct("["):
332	            inner = self.parse_type_ref()
333	            self.expect_punct("]")
334	            ref: TypeRef = ("list", inner)
335	        else:

337	        if self.eat_punct("!"):

341	    # -- values ----------------------------------------------------------------

343	    def parse_value(self, const: bool = False) -> Any:
344	        tok = self.peek()

346	            if const:

350	        if tok.kind == "int":

352	            return int(tok.value)
353	        if tok.kind == "float":
354	            self.advance()
355	            return float(tok.value)
356	        if tok.kind == "string":
357	            self.advance()
358	            return tok.value
359	        if tok.kind == "name":
360	            self.advance()
361	            if tok.value == "true":
362	                return True
363	            if tok.value == "false":
364	                return False
365	            if tok.value == "null":
366	                return None
367	            return EnumLiteral(tok.value)  # enum value
368	        if self.eat_punct("["):
369	            items = []
370	            while not self.eat_punct("]"):
371	                items.append(self.parse_value(const))
372	            return items
373	        if self.eat_punct("{"):
374	            obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
375	            while not self.eat_punct("}"):
376	                key = self.expect_name()
377	                if key in obj:

381	            return obj
382	        self.error(f"expected a value, found {self.describe()}")
383	
384	    def parse_directives(self, const: bool = False) -> List[Directive]:
385	        directives = []
386	        while self.eat_punct("@"):
387	            name = self.expect_name()
388	            args: Dict[str, Any] = {}
389	            if self.eat_punct("("):
390	                while not self.eat_punct(")"):
391	                    arg_name = self.expect_name()
392	                    if arg_name in args:
393	                        self.error(f"duplicate argument '{arg_name}' on '@{name}'")

398	
399	    # -- executable documents ---------------------------------------------------
400	
401	    def parse_selection_set(self) -> list:
402	        self.expect_punct("{")
403	        selections = []
404	        while not self.at_punct("}"):
405	            if self.peek().kind == "eof":
406	                self.error("unterminated selection set")

411	    def parse_selection(self):
412	        if self.eat_punct("..."):
413	            if self.at_name("on"):

415	                condition = self.expect_name()
416	                self.parse_directives()

418	            if self.at_punct("{") or self.at_punct("@"):

421	            name = self.expect_name()

424	        first = self.expect_name()
425	        alias = None
426	        name = first
427	        if self.eat_punct(":"):

445	def parse_executable(text: str, source: str):
446	    """Parse an executable document. Returns (operations, fragments)."""
447	    parser = Parser(text, source)
448	    operations: List[Operation] = []
449	    fragments: Dict[str, FragmentDef] = {}
450	    while parser.peek().kind != "eof":
451	        if parser.at_punct("{"):
452	            operations.append(Operation("query", None, [], parser.parse_selection_set()))
453	            continue
454	        if parser.at_name("query") or parser.at_name("mutation") or parser.at_name("subscription"):
455	            op_type = parser.advance().value
456	            name = None
457	            if parser.peek().kind == "name":
458	                name = parser.advance().value
459	            var_defs = []
460	            if parser.eat_punct("("):
461	                while not parser.eat_punct(")"):
462	                    parser.expect_punct("$")
463	                    var_name = parser.expect_name()
464	                    parser.expect_punct(":")
465	                    var_type = parser.parse_type_ref()
466	                    default = None
467	                    has_default = False
468	                    if parser.eat_punct("="):
469	                        default = parser.parse_value(const=True)
470	                        has_default = True
471	                    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
472	                    var_defs.append((var_name, var_type, default, has_default))
473	            parser.parse_directives()
474	            operations.append(Operation(op_type, name, var_defs, parser.parse_selection_set()))
475	            continue
476	        if parser.at_name("fragment"):
477	            parser.advance()
478	            frag_name = parser.expect_name()
479	            if frag_name == "on":
480	                parser.error("fragment name cannot be 'on'")
481	            if not parser.at_name("on"):
482	                parser.error("expected 'on' after fragment name")
483	            parser.advance()
484	            condition = parser.expect_name()
485	            parser.parse_directives()
486	            selection_set = parser.parse_selection_set()
487	            if frag_name in fragments:
488	                parser.error(f"duplicate fragment '{frag_name}'")
489	            fragments[frag_name] = FragmentDef(frag_name, condition, selection_set)
490	            continue
491	        parser.error(f"unexpected {parser.describe()}")
492	    return operations, fragments

496	# Schema (SDL) documents
497	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
498	
499	
500	class SdlDocument:
501	    def __init__(self):
502	        self.types: List[ObjectTypeDef] = []
503	        self.interfaces: List[ObjectTypeDef] = []
504	        self.inputs: List[InputDef] = []
505	        self.scalars: List[str] = []
506	        self.enums: List[EnumDef] = []
507	        self.directives: List[DirectiveDef] = []
508	        self.unions: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}

511	
512	
513	def _parse_field_def(parser: Parser) -> FieldDef:
514	    name = parser.expect_name()
515	    args: List[InputValueDef] = []
516	    if parser.eat_punct("("):
517	        while not parser.eat_punct(")"):
518	            if parser.peek().kind == "string":
519	                parser.advance()  # argument description
520	            args.append(_parse_input_value_def(parser))
521	    parser.expect_punct(":")
522	    type_ref = parser.parse_type_ref()
523	    directives = parser.parse_directives(const=True)
524	    return FieldDef(name, args, type_ref, directives)
525	
526	
527	def _parse_input_value_def(parser: Parser) -> InputValueDef:
528	    name = parser.expect_name()
529	    parser.expect_punct(":")
530	    type_ref = parser.parse_type_ref()
531	    default = None
532	    has_default = False
533	    if parser.eat_punct("="):
534	        default = parser.parse_value(const=True)
535	        has_default = True
536	    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
537	    return InputValueDef(name, type_ref, default, has_default)
538	
539	
540	def _parse_object_type(parser: Parser, is_extend: bool) -> ObjectTypeDef:
541	    name = parser.expect_name()
542	    interfaces: List[str] = []
543	    if parser.at_name("implements"):
544	        parser.advance()
545	        parser.eat_punct("&")
546	        interfaces.append(parser.expect_name())
547	        while parser.eat_punct("&"):
548	            interfaces.append(parser.expect_name())
549	    directives = parser.parse_directives(const=True)
550	    fields: List[FieldDef] = []
551	    if parser.eat_punct("{"):
552	        while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
553	            if parser.peek().kind == "string":
554	                parser.advance()  # field description
555	            fields.append(_parse_field_def(parser))
556	    return ObjectTypeDef(name, fields, directives, interfaces, is_extend)
557	
558	
559	def _parse_schema_body(parser: Parser, doc: SdlDocument) -> None:
560	    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
561	    parser.expect_punct("{")
562	    while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
563	        op = parser.expect_name()
564	        if op not in ("query", "mutation", "subscription"):
565	            parser.error(f"unknown root operation '{op}'")
566	        parser.expect_punct(":")
567	        type_name = parser.expect_name()
568	        if op in doc.roots:
569	            parser.error(f"duplicate root operation '{op}'")
570	        doc.roots[op] = type_name

573	def parse_schema_document(text: str, source: str) -> SdlDocument:
574	    parser = Parser(text, source)

  teams: [Team!]!
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  MEMBER
}

type User @entity(name: "users", key: "id") {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  status: String
  role: Role
  tags: [String!]
  team_id: ID
  team: Team @link(local: "team_id", target: "id")
  group: Org! @link(local: "team_id", target: "id")
  reviews: [Review!]! @link(local: "id", target: "user_id")
}

type Team @entity(name: "teams", key: "id") {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  league_id: ID
  league: League @link(local: "league_id", target: "id")
}

type League @entity(name: "leagues", key: "id") {
  id: ID!
  title: String!
}

type Org @entity(name: "orgs", key: "id") {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
}

type Review @entity(name: "reviews", key: "id") {
  id: ID!
  user_id: ID
  score: Int
}

type Thing @entity(name: "things", key: "id") {
  id: ID!
  owner: ID
}
"""

EVENTS = "\n".join(
    [
        json.dumps(row)
        for row in [
            {"op": "INSERT", "entity": "leagues", "before": None,
             "after": {"id": 5, "title": "L1"}},
            {"op": "INSERT", "entity": "orgs", "before": None,
             "after": {"id": 9, "name": "the-org"}},
            {"op": "INSERT", "entity": "teams", "before": None,
             "after": {"id": 9, "name": "core", "league_id": 5}},
            {"op": "INSERT", "entity": "reviews", "before": None,
             "after": {"id": "r1", "user_id": 1, "score": 10}},
            {"op": "INSERT", "entity": "reviews", "before": None,
             "after": {"id": "r2", "user_id": 1, "score": 20}},
            {"op": "INSERT", "entity": "users", "before": None,
             "after": {"id": 1, "name": "ada", "status": "active",
                       "role": "ADMIN", "tags": ["a", "b"], "team_id": 9}},
            {"op": "INSERT", "entity": "users", "before": None,
             "after": {"id": 2, "name": "bob", "status": "idle",
                       "role": "MEMBER", "tags": [], "team_id": None}},
            {"op": "UPDATE", "entity": "users",
             "before": {"id": 1, "name": "ada"},
             "after": {"id": 1, "name": "ada2", "status": "active",
                       "role": "ADMIN", "tags": ["x"], "team_id": 9}},
            {"op": "DELETE", "entity": "reviews",
             "before": {"id": "r2", "user_id": 1, "score": 20},
             "after": None},
        ]
    ]
) + "\n"

type Query {
  transfers(chain_id: Int, id: ID): [Transfer!]!
}

type Transfer @entity(name: "transfers", key: ["chain_id", "id"]) {
  chain_id: Int!
  id: ID!
  amount: Float
  token_chain: Int

}

type Token @entity(name: "tokens", key: ["chain_id", "id"]) {

  symbol: String!
}

type Line @entity(name: "lines", key: "id") {

def _event(op, entity, before, after):

class CliCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
